games without a dedicated thumbnail use the standard placeholder."]},{"label":"Changes","changes":["Replaced the earlier local game set and the 'more games soon' teaser with the new game list."]},{"label":"Fixes","changes":["Removed the Truffled corner logo and link from the local game pages.","The Backrooms now keeps a 16:9 aspect ratio instead of stretching to the window.","Plants vs. Zombies now uses a proper HTML/Ruffle wrapper instead of a gadget file."]}]},{"version":"1.5","date":"2026-11-21","type":"regular","title":"More Games On The Way","sections":[{"label":"Additions","changes":["A new 'We will be adding more games soon!' card in the Silverite games library.","The local games -3, 2048, and Cut the Rope are now listed under Silverite games."]},{"label":"Fixes","changes":["The fullscreen button in the game player no longer renders as a pure white block."]}]},{"version":"1.1.2","date":"2026-11-14","type":"regular","title":"Little Secrets, Cleaner Corners","sections":[{"label":"Additions","changes":["Click the home message to swap it. Land on the same one twice for a combo.","A new Credits tab.","A secret thing. Be gentle.","A small br4y signature in the rail.","Press Ctrl+K for a command palette that finds pages, tabs, and games.","HomeworkBot with Studi 1.0 answers questions, reads photos, and builds quizzes in Study mode.","A model picker next to the send button switches between Studi 1.0 and your own connected model.","HomeworkBot has a cleaner chat layout with quick-start cards and Normal and Study modes.","The Discord icon on the start menu now opens Discord inside the proxy."]},{"label":"Fixes","changes":["Settings no longer shows grid lines through its cards.","Every game library now sorts A–Z.","GN-MATH games load again."]}]}];</script>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#070b16">
<title>Silverite</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#090909;--panel:#111;--panel2:#171717;--line:#343434;--line2:#555;
  --white:#f4f4f4;--muted:#a2a2a2;--accent:#f0f0f0;--accent-rgb:240,240,240;--orange:var(--accent);--rail:46px;--tab-rail:46px;--top:48px;
  --pixel: "Press Start 2P", "Courier New", monospace;
  --ui-pixel: "Pixelify Sans", "Lucida Console", monospace;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:var(--bg);color:var(--white);font-family:var(--ui-pixel),Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}
body{overflow:hidden;background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 13% 18%,rgba(255,255,255,.09),transparent 29%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% 78%,rgba(255,255,255,.035),transparent 35%)}
button,input,select{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer;color:inherit}
.browser-top{height:var(--top);position:fixed;z-index:30;inset:0 0 auto 0;background:#050505;border-bottom:1px solid #292929;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:5px 7px}
.icon{display:block;width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.browser-btn .icon{width:17px;height:17px}.rail-btn .icon{width:19px;height:19px}.social-btn .icon{width:21px;height:21px}.search-submit .icon{width:20px;height:20px}.g4m3s-search-icon .icon{width:22px;height:22px}.tile-icon{width:23px;height:23px;display:block;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.game-fav .icon{width:16px;height:16px}.connect-btn .icon{width:14px;height:14px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:6px}
.browser-btn{height:34px;min-width:34px;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:#eee;display:grid;place-items:center}
.browser-btn:hover{background:#202020;border-color:#383838}
.address-wrap{height:33px;flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:center;margin:0 4px}
.address{font-family:var(--ui-pixel),monospace;height:33px;width:100%;border:1px solid #aaa;border-radius:20px;background:#080808;color:#eee;padding:0 14px;font-size:12px;outline:none}
.address:focus{border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
.workspace{position:fixed;inset:var(--top) 0 0 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:var(--tab-rail) minmax(0,1fr) var(--rail);min-height:0}
.workspace>.left-rail{grid-column:1}
.workspace>.stage{grid-column:2}
.workspace>.right-rail{grid-column:3}
.left-rail,.right-rail{z-index:15;background:#050505;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:10px 2px;overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.left-rail{border-right:1px solid #242424}
.right-rail{border-left:1px solid #242424}
.left-rail.hidden{display:none}.workspace.left-hidden{grid-template-columns:0 minmax(0,1fr) var(--rail)}
.workspace:not(.proxy-active){grid-template-columns:0 minmax(0,1fr) var(--rail)}
.workspace:not(.proxy-active) .left-rail{display:none}
.rail-btn{width:34px;height:35px;flex:none;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:9px;background:#171717;color:#eee;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.14s}
.rail-btn:hover{background:#2a2a2a;border-color:#666}
.rail-btn.active{background:#343434;border-color:#aaa;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.rail-spacer{flex:1;min-height:12px}
.rail-signature{flex:none;margin-top:-4px;color:#5c5c5c;font:7px var(--pixel),monospace;letter-spacing:1.5px;line-height:1;user-select:none;pointer-events:none;transition:color .18s,text-shadow .18s}
#fullscreen-btn:hover + .rail-signature{color:var(--accent);text-shadow:0 0 9px var(--accent-glow)}
.proxy-tab-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%}
.proxy-tab-item{position:relative;width:36px;height:38px;flex:none}
.proxy-tab-item .rail-btn{width:35px;height:38px}
.proxy-tab-item .rail-btn .icon{width:20px;height:20px}
.proxy-tab-item .rail-btn.proxy-tab{padding:0}
.proxy-tab-item .rail-btn .tab-favicon,.proxy-tab-item .rail-btn .tab-default-icon{grid-area:1/1;align-self:center;justify-self:center}
.proxy-tab-item .rail-btn .tab-favicon{display:block;width:20px;height:20px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:3px;background:transparent}
.proxy-tab-item .rail-btn .tab-favicon[hidden],.proxy-tab-item .rail-btn .tab-default-icon[hidden]{display:none!important}
.tab-close{position:absolute;right:-3px;top:-4px;width:16px;height:16px;border:1px solid #777;border-radius:50%;background:#222;color:#eee;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0;opacity:0;transition:opacity .12s;z-index:2}
.tab-close .icon{width:10px;height:10px}
.proxy-tab-item:hover .tab-close,.proxy-tab-item:focus-within .tab-close{opacity:1}
.tab-close:hover{background:#5a2226;border-color:#ff9ba1;color:#ffb2b6}
.stage{position:relative;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.view{display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-color:#555 #111;scrollbar-width:thin;animation:appear .22s ease both}
.view.active{display:block}
.view.home-view.active{display:flex}
.view[hidden]{display:none!important}
@keyframes appear{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
/* HOME */
.home-view{height:100%;min-height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:70px 22px 60px}
.clock{position:absolute;right:30px;top:16px;font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,39px);font-weight:300;letter-spacing:1px;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.22);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.home-center{width:min(650px,100%);margin-top:-35px;text-align:center}
.brand-logo{display:block;width:min(480px,84vw);margin:0 auto;line-height:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 9px rgba(0,0,0,.78)) drop-shadow(0 0 17px rgba(255,255,255,.12))}
.brand-logo img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;object-fit:contain}
.home-search-row{display:flex;gap:8px;max-width:560px;margin:29px auto 0}
.home-search{width:100%;height:51px;border:1px solid #777;border-radius:11px;background:rgba(5,5,5,.88);color:#fff;padding:0 18px;font-size:14px;outline:none;box-shadow:0 7px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.24)}
.home-search::placeholder{color:#aaa}.home-search:focus{border-color:#ddd;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.home-message{width:min(560px,100%);min-height:1.5em;margin:12px auto 0;padding:0 8px;color:var(--accent);opacity:.82;font:10px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1px;line-height:1.7;text-align:center;text-wrap:balance}
.home-message:empty{display:none}
.home-message[role="button"]{cursor:pointer;user-select:none;border-radius:5px;transition:opacity .16s,text-shadow .16s}
.home-message[role="button"]:hover{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 13px var(--accent-glow)}
.home-message[role="button"]:focus-visible{outline:1px dashed var(--accent-line);outline-offset:4px}
.home-message--swap{animation:home-message-swap .42s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1) both}
@keyframes home-message-swap{0%{opacity:.08;transform:translateY(6px) scale(.97)}100%{opacity:.82;transform:none}}
.home-message--combo{animation:home-message-combo .42s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1) 2}
@keyframes home-message-combo{0%,100%{transform:none}25%{transform:translateX(-4px) rotate(-1deg)}75%{transform:translateX(4px) rotate(1deg)}}
.home-combo{display:block;margin:7px auto 0;color:var(--accent);font:9px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1.6px;line-height:1;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
.home-combo:empty{display:none}
.home-combo.is-visible{animation:home-combo-pop 1.2s ease both}
@keyframes home-combo-pop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(5px) scale(.7)}18%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1.12)}68%{opacity:1;transform:none}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-7px) scale(.98)}}
.search-submit{width:51px;flex:none;border:1px solid #888;border-radius:11px;background:#262626;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center}.search-submit:hover{background:#3b3b3b}
.social-row{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-top:17px}
.social-btn{width:42px;height:42px;border:2px solid #777;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(34,34,34,.8);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #222}
.social-btn:hover{border-color:#fff;background:#3a3a3a;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.home-hint{margin-top:42px;color:#777;font:10px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1.4px}
/* GAME LIBRARY */
.g4m3s-view{padding:25px clamp(15px,3.4vw,48px) 45px;min-height:100%;}
.g4m3s-search-wrap{width:min(600px,100%);height:55px;margin:0 auto 23px;position:relative}
.g4m3s-search{width:100%;height:100%;padding:0 52px 0 20px;border:2px solid #e5e5e5;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(5,5,5,.87);color:#fff;font-family:var(--pixel);font-size:17px;outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
.g4m3s-search::placeholder{color:#818181}.g4m3s-search:focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.g4m3s-search-icon{position:absolute;right:15px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);pointer-events:none}
.game-count{text-align:center;color:var(--orange);font: bold 14px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1px;margin:17px 0 13px;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,181,46,.22)}
.library-filter-bar{width:min(820px,100%);margin:0 auto 17px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;overflow-x:auto;padding:5px 5px 11px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--accent-line) transparent}
.library-filter-btn{position:relative;width:44px;height:44px;flex:0 0 44px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:6px;background:rgba(14,14,14,.92);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#eee;transition:border-color .16s,background .16s,transform .16s,box-shadow .16s;overflow:visible;padding:0}
.library-filter-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-tint);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.library-filter-btn.active{border:2px solid #fff;background:var(--accent-tint-strong);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.18),0 0 13px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.library-filter-btn[data-library-filter="ALL"]{width:auto;flex-basis:auto;min-width:44px;padding:0 13px}
.library-filter-label{position:relative;z-index:1;font:700 10px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1.4px;line-height:1;color:#f4f4f4}
.library-filter-btn[data-library-filter="FAVORITES"]{color:#ff7a84}
.library-filter-heart{width:20px;height:20px;display:block;position:relative;z-index:1;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.library-filter-btn[data-library-filter="FAVORITES"]:hover .library-filter-heart,.library-filter-btn[data-library-filter="FAVORITES"].active .library-filter-heart{fill:currentColor}
.library-filter-logo{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:4px;display:block;z-index:0}
.library-filter-fallback{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 11px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:-.4px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 5px #000;pointer-events:none}
.library-filter-btn:has(.library-filter-logo:not([hidden])) .library-filter-fallback{display:none}
.library-filter-count{position:absolute;right:-4px;bottom:-5px;min-width:17px;height:17px;padding:0 4px;border:1px solid #090909;border-radius:9px;background:var(--accent);color:#080808;font:700 9px var(--pixel);display:grid;place-items:center;z-index:2}
.library-filter-btn.is-special .library-filter-count{display:none}
@media(max-width:760px){.library-filter-bar{justify-content:flex-start;margin-bottom:13px;gap:7px}.library-filter-btn{width:38px;height:38px;flex-basis:38px}.library-filter-btn[data-library-filter="ALL"]{flex-basis:auto}.library-filter-logo{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.library-filter-heart{width:18px;height:18px}.library-filter-label{font-size:9px}}

.game-grid{width:min(1100px,100%);margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
.game-card{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;position:relative;border:2px solid #e8e8e8;border-radius:6px;background:#080808;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #555,0 9px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:transform .16s,border-color .16s}
.game-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #777,0 13px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.game-art{height:137px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center;border-bottom:2px solid #e8e8e8;background:#222}
.game-art:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.15),transparent 45%,rgba(0,0,0,.25)),repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 0 2px,transparent 2px 12px)}
.game-art:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:70%;height:58%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);transform:rotate(-12deg);box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.art-glyph-svg{position:relative;z-index:1;width:64px;height:64px;color:#fff;filter:drop-shadow(3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.7)) drop-shadow(0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,.24));transform:rotate(-5deg)}.art-glyph{position:relative;z-index:1;font-family:var(--pixel);font-weight:1000;font-size:clamp(38px,4vw,62px);line-height:1;color:#fff;text-shadow:3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.7),0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,.24);transform:rotate(-5deg)}
.art-brown{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,#c4a16c,#5c3526 75%)}.art-red{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,#ff4c45,#52171c 78%)}.art-blue{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,#236cc4,#101e50 78%)}.art-pool{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#167ac4,#07325b 78%)}.art-paper{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d6c9a6,#94886e)}.art-violet{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#8e76c8,#252044 78%)}.art-mint{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#4fc6af,#153d42 78%)}.art-orange{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#f6a24d,#632f1d 78%)}.art-gray{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,#a5a5a5,#292929 78%)}.art-pink{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#ee75b0,#51204c 78%)}.art-green{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#6aab53,#16341d 78%)}.art-gold{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#e8c84b,#5b4214 78%)}
.game-art.has-thumb{background:#111;isolation:isolate}
.game-art .game-thumb{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;z-index:0;display:block}
.game-art.has-thumb:before{z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.04),rgba(0,0,0,.22))}
.game-art.has-thumb:after{display:none}
.game-art .thumb-fallback{display:none}
.game-art:not(.has-thumb) .thumb-fallback{display:block}
.game-art .game-fav{z-index:3}

.game-fav{position:absolute;z-index:3;right:7px;top:7px;width:29px;height:29px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(20,20,20,.58);color:#ddd;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0}
.game-fav:hover,.game-fav.favorited{background:rgba(20,20,20,.86);color:#ff5c68;border-color:#fff}.game-fav.favorited .icon{fill:currentColor}
.game-name{height:35px;padding:7px 8px 5px;background:#080808;color:#f7f7f7;text-align:center;font: bold 13px var(--pixel);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;border-bottom:2px solid #e6e6e6}
.game-source{height:18px;padding:3px 5px 1px;text-align:center;color:var(--accent);font:8px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1px;opacity:.65;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent-line)}
.load-more-games{grid-column:1/-1;justify-self:center;width:min(260px,100%);margin:10px auto 3px}
.play-btn{height:37px;width:calc(100% - 6px);margin:3px;border:2px solid #111;border-radius:3px;background:#f1f1f1;color:#050505;font: bold 14px var(--pixel);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #777}
.play-btn:hover{background:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #333;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.empty{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;color:#a9a9a9;border:1px dashed #555;padding:35px 12px;font:13px var(--pixel)}
/* PROXY + SETTINGS */
.standard-view{padding:34px clamp(18px,4vw,55px) 50px;max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;min-height:100%;}
.eyebrow{color:var(--orange);font:11px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase}
h1{font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,51px);letter-spacing:-1.7px;margin:13px 0 10px}.lede{color:#aaa;line-height:1.7;font-size:14px;max-width:630px;margin:0}
.proxy-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:15px;margin-top:27px}
.panel{border:1px solid #444;background:rgba(12,12,12,.91);padding:22px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 9px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.panel h2{font-size:17px;margin:0}.panel p{color:#aaa;font-size:12px;line-height:1.65}
.field-label{display:block;color:#bbb;font:10px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1px;margin:18px 0 8px}
.url-row{display:flex;gap:8px}.url-input{height:43px;flex:1;min-width:0;border:1px solid #666;border-radius:5px;background:#050505;color:#fff;padding:0 12px;outline:none}.url-input:focus{border-color:#ddd}
.connect-btn{border:1px solid #eee;border-radius:5px;background:#eee;color:#050505;padding:0 16px;font: bold 12px var(--pixel)}.connect-btn:hover{background:#fff}
.engine-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:17px}.engine-row .field-label{margin:0}.engine-select{height:34px;border:1px solid #555;background:#161616;color:#eee;border-radius:4px;padding:0 9px}
.engine-note{color:#888;font-size:11px}
.notice{margin-top:20px;border:1px solid #5b4829;background:rgba(255,181,46,.06);padding:12px;border-radius:5px;color:#c7b18a;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6}
.engine-card{border:1px solid #3b3b3b;padding:12px;margin-top:10px;background:#151515;border-radius:5px}.engine-card strong{font-size:12px}.engine-card p{margin:7px 0 0;font-size:11px}.pill{float:right;color:var(--orange);font:9px var(--pixel);border:1px solid #66502a;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:3px}
.settings-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:26px;align-items:start}.settings-card{min-width:0;border:1px solid #3d3d3d;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(20,20,20,.97),rgba(10,10,10,.96));border-radius:8px;padding:18px 18px 8px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}.settings-card-head{padding:0 0 /* Custom cursor images selected or uploaded in Settings. */
html[data-cursor="custom"] *{cursor:var(--custom-cursor,auto)!important}
html[data-cursor="custom"] input,html[data-cursor="custom"] textarea,html[data-cursor="custom"] [contenteditable="true"]{cursor:text!important}
.cursor-image-editor{padding:16px 19px 17px;border-top:1px solid #282828;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.035),rgba(0,0,0,.12))}
.cursor-image-editor[hidden]{display:none!important}
.cursor-image-editor-heading{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;margin-bottom:14px}
.cursor-image-editor-heading b{display:block;color:#eaeaea;font-size:11px}
.cursor-image-editor-heading small{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#828282;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;max-width:560px}
.cursor-image-format,.cursor-image-upload-label{color:var(--accent);font:8px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.55px;white-space:nowrap}
.cursor-image-tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:15px;align-items:end}
.cursor-image-url-field label,.cursor-image-upload-label{display:block;margin-bottom:7px;color:#858585;font:8px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.8px}
.cursor-image-url-row{display:flex;gap:7px;min-width:0}
.cursor-image-url-input{width:100%;min-width:0;height:36px;border:1px solid #454545;border-radius:4px;background:#080808;color:#eee;padding:0 10px;font:10px var(--ui-pixel);outline:none}
.cursor-image-url-input:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.1)}
.cursor-image-action,.cursor-image-upload-button{height:36px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--accent-line);border-radius:4px;background:var(--accent-tint);color:var(--accent);font:8px var(--pixel);white-space:nowrap;transition:.15s}
.cursor-image-action:hover,.cursor-image-upload-button:hover{background:var(--accent-tint-strong);border-color:var(--accent)}
.cursor-image-upload-field{min-width:max-content}
.cursor-image-upload-button{cursor:pointer}
.cursor-image-upload-button svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.cursor-image-file-input{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;padding:0!important;margin:-1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border:0!important}
.cursor-image-file-input:focus-visible+.cursor-image-upload-button{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}
.cursor-image-preview-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;margin-top:14px;padding-top:13px;border-top:1px solid #252525}
.cursor-image-preview-box{width:66px;height:66px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #3c3c3c;border-radius:5px;background-color:#151515;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,#222 25%,transparent 25%),linear-gradient(-45deg,#222 25%,transparent 25%),linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 75%,#222 75%),linear-gradient(-45deg,transparent 75%,#222 75%);background-size:12px 12px;background-position:0 0,0 6px,6px -6px,-6px 0}
.cursor-image-preview-box img{max-width:54px;max-height:54px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:auto}
.cursor-image-preview-box span{color:#696969;font:7px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.2px}
.cursor-image-preview-copy{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px}
.cursor-image-preview-copy b{color:#ddd;font-size:10px}
.cursor-image-preview-copy small{color:#777;font-size:9px;line-height:1.45}
.cursor-image-clear{margin-top:3px;padding:5px 0;border:0;background:transparent;color:#999;font:7px var(--pixel);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.cursor-image-clear:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.cursor-image-clear:disabled{opacity:.35;text-decoration:none;cursor:not-allowed}
.cursor-image-footnote{margin-top:11px;color:#666;font-size:9px;line-height:1.45}
@media(max-width:560px){.cursor-image-editor{padding:14px 13px}.cursor-image-editor-heading{flex-direction:column;gap:7px}.cursor-image-tools{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}.cursor-image-upload-field{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.cursor-image-upload-field .cursor-image-upload-label{margin:0}.cursor-image-upload-button{min-width:130px}}
@media(max-width:760px){.settings-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.settings-reset-card{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.range-control{width:min(280px,100%)}}
.toast{position:fixed;z-index:50;left:50%;bottom:22px;transform:translate(-50%,12px);padding:11px 16px;border:1px solid #777;border-radius:5px;background:#111;color:#fff;font:11px var(--pixel);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.18s;max-width:min(90vw,600px);text-align:center}.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media(max-width:1050px){.game-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.game-art{height:130px}}
@media(max-width:760px){:root{--rail:42px;--tab-rail:42px}.game-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}.g4m3s-view{padding:20px 12px 35px}.game-art{height:116px}.proxy-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.clock{right:16px;top:13px;font-size:25px}.home-center{margin-top:0}}
@media(max-width:430px){:root{--top:45px;--rail:39px;--tab-rail:39px}.browser-btn{min-width:29px;padding:0 5px}.address{font-size:11px;padding:0 10px}.game-grid{gap:8px}.game-art{height:95px}.game-name{font-size:11px}.play-btn{font-size:12px;height:34px}.g4m3s-search{font-size:14px}.home-search{font-size:12px}.social-btn{width:38px;height:38px}.standard-view{padding:25px 15px 40px}.panel{padding:17px}.url-row{flex-direction:column}.connect-btn{height:39px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

/* Silverite startup animation */
#silverite-loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;background:#080808;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#f5f5f5;font-family:'Pixelify Sans',monospace;transition:opacity .62s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1),visibility .62s ease}
#silverite-loader:before,#silverite-loader:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-20%;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1}
#silverite-loader:before{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 43%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.14),transparent 36%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 110%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.08),transparent 45%);filter:blur(12px);animation:loader-aura 4.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#silverite-loader:after{inset:0;opacity:.18;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 5px,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 6px,transparent 7px);mask-image:linear-gradient(transparent,#000 18%,#000 82%,transparent)}
#silverite-loader.loader-done{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
#silverite-loader.loader-finish{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.035);pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .82s cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.25,1),transform .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.loader-inner{position:relative;z-index:1;width:min(390px,calc(100vw - 44px));text-align:center;animation:loader-rise .85s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}
.loader-brand{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:34px;animation:loader-brand-in 1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}
.loader-brand:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-18px -35px;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 35%,rgba(255,255,255,.24) 50%,transparent 65%);transform:translateX(-125%);animation:loader-sweep 1.5s .45s ease-out both}
.loader-logo{display:block;width:min(260px,75vw);height:auto;max-height:100px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.22));animation:loader-logo-glow 2.8s .7s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.loader-status{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:10px;transition:opacity .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.loader-file{font-size:12px;color:#a3a3a3;min-height:18px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin-bottom:18px;transition:opacity .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.loader-status.is-changing,.loader-file.is-changing{opacity:.25;transform:translateY(3px)}
.loader-track{position:relative;height:7px;overflow:hidden;background:#242424;border:1px solid #3b3b3b;padding:1px;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.08);animation:loader-track-in .6s .25s both}
.loader-fill{position:relative;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.72),var(--accent));box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--accent-glow);transition:width .34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.loader-fill:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;width:30%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.8),transparent);animation:loader-fill-shine 1.15s ease-in-out infinite}
.loader-hint{margin-top:12px;font-size:10px;color:#777;letter-spacing:1.5px;animation:loader-hint-in .7s .38s both}
#silverite-loader.loader-done .loader-inner{animation:none;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px) scale(.97);filter:blur(3px);transition:opacity .42s ease,transform .52s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),filter .42s ease}
#silverite-loader.loader-finish .loader-inner{animation:loader-exit .8s cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.25,1) both}
#silverite-loader.loader-finish .loader-status,#silverite-loader.loader-finish .loader-file,#silverite-loader.loader-finish .loader-track,#silverite-loader.loader-finish .loader-hint{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px);transition:opacity .28s ease,transform .38s ease}
@keyframes loader-rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px) scale(.985)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes loader-exit{to{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.18);filter:blur(5px)}}
@keyframes loader-brand-in{from{opacity:0;filter:blur(5px)}to{opacity:1;filter:blur(0)}}
@keyframes loader-sweep{0%{transform:translateX(-125%);opacity:0}20%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translateX(125%);opacity:0}}
@keyframes loader-logo-glow{from{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12))}to{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 23px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.3))}}
@keyframes loader-aura{from{transform:scale(.96);opacity:.62}to{transform:scale(1.06);opacity:1}}
@keyframes loader-track-in{from{opacity:0;transform:scaleX(.88)}to{opacity:1;transform:scaleX(1)}}
@keyframes loader-fill-shine{from{transform:translateX(-140%)}to{transform:translateX(440%)}}
@keyframes loader-hint-in{from{opacity:0;letter-spacing:3px}to{opacity:1;letter-spacing:1.5px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#silverite-loader,.loader-inner,.loader-brand,.loader-logo,.loader-track,.loader-hint,.loader-fill,#silverite-loader.loader-done .loader-inner,#silverite-loader.loader-finish .loader-inner{animation:none!important;transition:opacity .12s ease,visibility .12s ease!important;filter:none!important;transform:none!important}}


/* Main navigation and game library layout */
.left-rail .rail-btn,.right-rail .rail-btn{width:35px;height:38px}
.left-rail .rail-btn .icon,.right-rail .rail-btn .icon{width:20px;height:20px}
.g4m3s-view{padding-top:19px}
.g4m3s-brand{width:min(215px,62vw);margin:0 auto 20px;line-height:0}
.g4m3s-brand img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;image-rendering:pixelated;object-fit:contain}
.g4m3s-heading{text-align:center;margin:0 auto 18px}
.g4m3s-heading h1{font:clamp(25px,4vw,36px) var(--pixel);letter-spacing:-1px;margin:11px 0 8px}
.g4m3s-heading .lede{font-size:12px;margin:0 auto}
.g4m3s-heading .eyebrow{font-size:9px}
/* Dedicated game player */
.player-view{padding:26px clamp(15px,3.2vw,42px) 42px;max-width:1500px;margin:0 auto;min-height:100%;}
.player-heading{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.player-title-wrap h1{font:clamp(21px,3vw,34px) var(--pixel);letter-spacing:-1px;margin:7px 0 8px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.player-info-bottom{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:flex-start;margin-top:19px;padding:0 2px;}
.player-info-bottom .player-title-wrap{min-width:0;}
.player-info-bottom .eyebrow{margin:0 0 5px;}
.player-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:#999;font:9px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.4px}
.player-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#777;display:inline-block}
.player-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.player-control{width:39px;height:39px;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:5px;background:#151515;color:#eee;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.14s}
.player-control:hover{background:#303030;border-color:#aaa;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.player-control .icon{width:18px;height:18px}
.close-control{border-color:#75464a;color:#ff9ba1}
.close-control:hover{background:#3a1c1f;border-color:#ff9ba1}
.fullscreen-control{background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.2);color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent-line)}
.fullscreen-control:hover{background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.32);color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.player-shell{border:2px solid #777;background:#050505;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #444,0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.35);overflow:hidden}
.player-screen{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;min-height:260px;max-height:calc(100vh - 245px);background:#030303;display:grid;place-items:center}
.player-screen iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:#030303}
.player-screen iframe[hidden]{display:none}
.player-empty{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:24px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 48%,#1c1c1c 0,#090909 58%,#030303 100%);overflow:auto}
.player-empty-icon{width:66px;height:66px;color:#aaa;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:10px;background:#151515;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #333;margin-bottom:21px}
.player-empty-icon svg{width:39px;height:39px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.player-empty-kicker{font:9px var(--pixel);color:#8e8e8e;letter-spacing:1.4px}
.player-empty h2{font:clamp(15px,2.2vw,23px) var(--pixel);margin:16px 0 10px;color:#f5f5f5}
.player-empty p{max-width:480px;color:#888;font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;margin:0}
.player-footer{height:34px;padding:0 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:#0c0c0c;border-top:1px solid #333;color:#7f7f7f;font:8px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.5px}
.player-footer b{color:#ddd;font-weight:400;margin-left:5px}
.player-shell:fullscreen{width:100vw;height:100vh;border:0;box-shadow:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.player-shell:fullscreen .player-screen{flex:1;aspect-ratio:auto;max-height:none;min-height:0}
.player-shell:fullscreen .player-footer{flex:none}
@media(max-width:760px){.player-screen{aspect-ratio:4/3;min-height:230px;max-height:none}.player-heading{align-items:flex-start}.player-toolbar{width:100%;justify-content:flex-end}.player-info-bottom{margin-top:15px}}
@media(max-width:430px){.player-view{padding:18px 10px 30px}.player-control{width:35px;height:35px}.player-screen{min-height:220px}.player-empty p{font-size:11px}.player-footer{font-size:7px}}


/* CURSOR BACKGROUND GLOW */
.workspace{z-index:2}
body::after{
  content:"";
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:1;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:0;
  background:radial-gradient(
    390px circle at var(--cursor-x, 50%) var(--cursor-y, 50%),
    rgba(var(--accent-rgb),var(--glow-opacity,.115)) 0%,
    rgba(var(--accent-rgb),var(--glow-mid-opacity,.055)) 32%,
    rgba(var(--accent-rgb),var(--glow-low-opacity,.018)) 52%,
    transparent 74%
  );
  transition:opacity .22s ease;
}
body.cursor-glow-active::after{opacity:1}
@media (pointer:coarse){body::after{display:none}}


/* SILVERITE GLOBAL ACCENT SYSTEM
   All interface chrome follows --accent / --accent-rgb at runtime.
   Brand logo and dark surfaces stay neutral for contrast. */
:root{
  --accent-tint:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.13);
  --accent-tint-strong:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.22);
  --accent-line:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.62);
  --accent-glow:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.28);
  --accent-glow-soft:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.14);
}

/* Background grid and glow */
body:not(.hide-grid){
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 13% 18%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.10),transparent 29%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% 78%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.055),transparent 35%);
}
body.hide-grid{
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 13% 18%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12),transparent 29%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% 78%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.065),transparent 35%);
}
.workspace{background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 48%,rgba(0,0,0,.30) 100%),linear-gradient(rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.105) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.105) 1px,transparent 1px),radial-gradient(ellipse at 13% 18%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.10),transparent 29%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 78% 78%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.055),transparent 35%);background-size:auto,68px 68px,68px 68px,auto,auto;background-position:0 0,44px 48px,44px 48px,0 0,0 0}
body.hide-grid .workspace{background-image:none}

/* Every inline SVG icon gets its color from the selected accent. */
svg{color:var(--accent)!important}
svg.icon,svg.tile-icon,button svg,.player-empty-icon svg{
  color:var(--accent)!important;
  stroke:currentColor!important;
}
.icon,.tile-icon{color:var(--accent)!important}
.art-glyph-svg{color:var(--accent)!important;stroke:var(--accent)!important;filter:drop-shadow(3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.75)) drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.35))}
.art-glyph{color:var(--accent)!important;text-shadow:3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.75),0 0 16px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.35)}

/* Browser chrome */
.browser-top{border-bottom-color:var(--accent-line)}
.browser-btn{color:var(--accent);border-color:transparent}
.browser-btn:hover{color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-tint);border-color:var(--accent-line);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.address{border-color:var(--accent-line);caret-color:var(--accent)}
.address:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent-tint-strong),0 0 16px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.address::selection,.home-search::selection,.g4m3s-search::selection{background:var(--accent);color:#080808}

/* Both sidebars, proxy tabs, selected/hover states */
.left-rail,.right-rail{border-color:var(--accent-line)}
.rail-btn{color:var(--accent);border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.24);background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.055)}
.rail-btn:hover{color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-tint-strong);border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 13px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.rail-btn.active{color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-tint-strong);border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.18),0 0 15px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.rail-btn.active svg,.rail-btn:hover svg{color:var(--accent)!important}
.tab-close{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent-line);background:#171717}
.tab-close:hover{color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-tint-strong);border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.proxy-tab.active{border-color:var(--accent)}

/* Main-page search, social shortcuts, and labels */
.home-search,.g4m3s-search,.url-input,.engine-select{border-color:var(--accent-line);caret-color:var(--accent)}
.home-search:focus,.g4m3s-search:focus,.url-input:focus,.engine-select:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-tint),0 0 18px var(--accent-glow-soft);outline-color:var(--accent)}
.search-submit{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-tint-strong);color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.14)}
.search-submit:hover{background:var(--accent);color:#080808;box-shadow:0 0 18px var(--accent-glow)}
.social-btn{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent-line);background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.07);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.08),0 0 0 rgba(var(--accent-rgb),0)}
.social-btn:hover{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-tint-strong);box-shadow:0 0 16px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.home-hint{color:var(--accent)}
.g4m3s-search{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.8),0 0 13px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.g4m3s-search-icon{color:var(--accent)}

/* Games library and placeholder cards */
.game-count{color:var(--accent);text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--accent-glow)}
.game-card{border-color:var(--accent-line);box-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.28),0 9px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.game-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 5px 0 rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.45),0 13px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 0 16px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.game-card .game-art{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.42),rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12) 50%,#090909 100%)!important;border-bottom-color:var(--accent-line)}
.game-art:before{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.16),transparent 45%,rgba(0,0,0,.28)),repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.11) 0 2px,transparent 2px 12px)}
.game-art:after{border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.38);box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12)}
.game-fav{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent-line);background:rgba(8,8,8,.76)}
.game-fav:hover,.game-fav.favorited{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-tint-strong)}
.game-name{color:var(--accent);border-bottom-color:var(--accent-line)}
.play-btn{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#080808;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 2px 0 rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.32)}
.play-btn:hover{background:var(--accent);color:#080808;filter:brightness(1.12);box-shadow:0 0 17px var(--accent-glow)}
.empty{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent-line)}

/* Proxy panels, forms, notices and engine selection */
.eyebrow,.field-label,.settings-kicker,.pill{color:var(--accent)}
.panel{border-color:var(--accent-line);box-shadow:0 9px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.2),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12)}
.url-input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.connect-btn{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent);color:#080808;box-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.28)}
.connect-btn:hover{background:var(--accent);filter:brightness(1.1);box-shadow:0 0 16px var(--accent-glow)}
.notice{border-color:var(--accent-line);background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.075);color:var(--accent)}
.engine-card{border-color:var(--accent-line);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.10)}
.pill{border-color:var(--accent-line);background:var(--accent-tint)}

/* Settings cards, toggles, selects and reset action */
.settings-card{border-color:var(--accent-line);box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.18),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.13)}
.settings-card h2{color:var(--accent)}
.settings-divider{background:var(--accent-line)}
.setting input[type=checkbox]{accent-color:var(--accent)}
.switch input:checked+span{background:var(--accent-tint-strong);border-color:var(--accent)}
.switch input:checked+span:before{background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 11px var(--accent-glow)}
.range-control input{accent-color:var(--accent)}
.range-control output{color:var(--accent)}
.engine-select{color:var(--accent)}
.reset-settings-btn{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent);color:#080808;box-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.25)}
.reset-settings-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent);color:#080808;filter:brightness(1.1);box-shadow:0 0 16px var(--accent-glow)}
.footer-note{color:var(--accent)}
button:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}

/* Player controls and game frame chrome */
.player-meta{color:var(--accent)}
.player-dot{background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent-glow)}
.player-control{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent-line);background:var(--accent-tint)}
.player-control:hover{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-tint-strong);box-shadow:0 0 13px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.close-control,.close-control:hover{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.close-control:hover{background:var(--accent-tint-strong)}
.fullscreen-control,.fullscreen-control:hover{background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.2);color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent-line)}
.fullscreen-control:hover{background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.32);border-color:var(--accent)}
.player-shell{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.35),0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 0 17px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.player-empty-icon{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent-line);background:var(--accent-tint);box-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.22),0 0 15px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.player-empty-kicker,.player-empty h2{color:var(--accent)}
.player-footer{border-top-color:var(--accent-line)}
.player-footer b{color:var(--accent)}

/* Compact player header and controls */
.player-view{padding-top:20px}
.player-heading{justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:13px;padding:0 2px}
.player-info-bottom{margin:0;padding:0;min-width:0;flex:1}
.player-info-bottom .eyebrow{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.3px;color:#858585}
.player-title-wrap h1{font:clamp(17px,2vw,25px) var(--ui-pixel);letter-spacing:0;margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.25}
.player-meta{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.8px}
.player-toolbar{gap:5px;flex-wrap:nowrap;padding:5px;border:1px solid rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.18);border-radius:9px;background:rgba(8,8,8,.78);box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.player-control{width:35px;height:35px;border-radius:6px;background:transparent}
.player-control:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.fullscreen-control,.fullscreen-control:hover{background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.2);color:var(--accent)}
.fullscreen-control:hover{background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.32)}
.close-control{margin-left:3px;border-left-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.2);border-radius:6px}
.player-shell{border-width:1px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.38),0 0 18px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.player-screen{border-radius:7px 7px 0 0}
.player-footer{height:30px;padding:0 13px;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.6px}
@media(max-width:760px){.player-heading{align-items:center}.player-toolbar{width:auto;justify-content:flex-end}.player-info-bottom{margin:0}}
@media(max-width:560px){.player-heading{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}.player-toolbar{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start}.player-control{width:36px;height:36px}.player-view{padding-top:16px}}

/* Toasts, loader progress and scrollbars */
.toast{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45),0 0 18px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
#silverite-loader .loader-status,#silverite-loader .loader-status-text{color:var(--accent)}
#silverite-loader .loader-track{border-color:var(--accent-line)}
#silverite-loader .loader-fill{background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--accent-glow)}
#silverite-loader .loader-file{color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.82)}
.view{scrollbar-color:var(--accent) #111}
.view::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,.left-rail::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,.right-rail::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--accent);border-radius:8px}
a{color:var(--accent)}

.changelog-view{padding:34px clamp(18px,4vw,55px) 55px}
.changelog-wrap{width:min(900px,100%);margin:0 auto}
.changelog-empty{margin-top:25px;padding:22px;border:1px solid #353535;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(12,12,12,.92);color:#fff;font-size:16px;text-align:center}
.changelog-list{margin-top:25px}
.changelog-entry{margin:0 0 13px;padding:20px 22px;border:1px solid #353535;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(12,12,12,.92);color:#fff}
.changelog-entry-heading{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.changelog-entry-titlebar{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;min-width:0}
.changelog-entry-heading h2{margin:0;color:#fff;font:27px/1.3 var(--ui-pixel)}
.changelog-rank{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:25px;padding:3px 8px;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:4px;background:#262626;color:#fff;font:9px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.25px;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.changelog-rank--hotfix{border-color:#c34850;background:#4b2024}
.changelog-rank--major{border-color:#d1a443;background:#4b3b1c}
.changelog-rank--games{border-color:#54a878;background:#1e402e}
.changelog-date{color:#fff;font:12px var(--pixel);white-space:nowrap}
.changelog-entry-title{margin:13px 0 0;color:#fff;font-size:16px;line-height:1.65}
.changelog-changes{margin:14px 0 0;padding-left:22px;color:#fff;font-size:15px;line-height:1.9}
.changelog-changes li::marker{color:#fff}
.changelog-tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:14px}
.changelog-tab{padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #454545;border-radius:5px;background:#171717;color:#a9a9a9;font:9px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s,color .15s}
.changelog-tab:hover{border-color:#777;color:#fff}
.changelog-tab.is-active{border-color:var(--accent);background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12);color:#fff}
.changelog-tab:focus-visible{outline:1px dashed var(--accent-line);outline-offset:2px}
.changelog-panel[hidden]{display:none}
.changelog-older-toggle{margin-top:5px;padding:11px 15px;border:1px solid #505050;border-radius:5px;background:#151515;color:#fff;font:12px var(--pixel);cursor:pointer}
.changelog-older-toggle:hover{border-color:var(--accent);background:#202020}
.changelog-older-toggle[hidden]{display:none}
@media(max-width:600px){.changelog-view{padding:25px 15px 40px}}

/* Credits: a simple card grid for the people and projects behind Silverite. */
.credits-view{padding:34px clamp(18px,4vw,55px) 55px}
.credits-wrap{width:min(1000px,100%);margin:0 auto}
.credits-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(225px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:26px}
.credit-card{position:relative;min-width:0;padding:20px 20px 22px;border:1px solid #353535;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(17,17,17,.97),rgba(10,10,10,.97));box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.18);overflow:hidden}
.credit-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--accent-tint),transparent 55%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;pointer-events:none}
.credit-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent-line)}
.credit-card:hover:before{opacity:1}
.credit-card--lead{border-color:var(--accent-line);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--accent-glow-soft),0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.credit-card--wide{grid-column:span 2}
.credit-providers{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px 18px;margin:15px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.credit-providers li{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-width:0}
.credit-providers b{color:#e8e8e8;font:11px var(--ui-pixel)}
.credit-providers span{color:#8f8f8f;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5}
.credit-kicker{position:relative;color:var(--accent);font:8px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1.2px;line-height:1.4}
.credit-card h2{position:relative;margin:10px 0 7px;color:#f2f2f2;font:20px/1.25 var(--ui-pixel)}
.credit-card p{position:relative;margin:0;color:#9a9a9a;font-size:11px;line-height:1.65}
.credit-tag{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;margin-top:13px;padding:4px 7px;border:1px solid var(--accent-line);border-radius:4px;background:var(--accent-tint);color:var(--accent);font:7px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1.2px}
.credits-footer{margin-top:26px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid #242424;color:#646464;font:8px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1.2px}
@media(max-width:600px){.credits-view{padding:25px 15px 40px}.credits-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.credit-card--wide{grid-column:auto}.credit-providers{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.settings-nav-icon{width:19px;height:19px;stroke-width:1.7;transform:translateY(-.25px)}

.proxy-frame-container{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;display:none;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
#view-proxy.is-browsing .proxy-frame-container{display:block}
#view-proxy.is-browsing .home-center,#view-proxy.is-browsing .clock{display:none}
.proxy-frame{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:none;border:0;background:#fff}
.proxy-frame.is-active{display:block}
.proxy-loading{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:4;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;background:rgba(4,6,9,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(.8);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(.8);color:var(--white);animation:proxy-loading-in .18s ease both}
.proxy-loading[hidden]{display:none!important}
.proxy-loading-spinner{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.16);border-top-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.22);animation:proxy-loading-spin .85s linear infinite}
.proxy-loading-label{font-family:var(--pixel),monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(244,244,244,.85);text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
@keyframes proxy-loading-spin{to{transform:rotate(1turn)}}
@keyframes proxy-loading-in{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.proxy-loading-spinner{animation-duration:2.6s}}
.proxy-diagnostics{position:absolute;z-index:12;right:18px;bottom:18px;width:min(640px,calc(100% - 36px));max-height:min(58vh,520px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid #484848;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(12,12,12,.97);color:#eee;box-shadow:0 14px 45px #0009;font:12px/1.5 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace}
.proxy-diagnostics[hidden]{display:none}
.proxy-diagnostics-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:10px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid #303030;font:9px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.4px}
.proxy-diagnostics-header strong span{margin-left:7px;color:#9a9a9a;font:8px var(--ui-pixel)}
.proxy-diagnostics-header button{width:28px;height:28px;border:1px solid #383838;border-radius:5px;background:#181818;color:#fff;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer}
#diagnostics-output{margin:0;padding:12px 14px;overflow:auto;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#e8e8e8;font:11px/1.55 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;user-select:text}

/* SETTINGS PAGE REDESIGN: category rail + one aligned content column */
.settings-view{padding:clamp(20px,3vw,38px) clamp(16px,3.2vw,44px) 44px;max-width:none;min-height:100%;}
.settings-page-heading{width:min(1180px,100%);margin:0 auto 24px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;}
.settings-heading-copy{min-width:0;}
.settings-page-heading h1{margin:9px 0 8px;font-size:clamp(31px,4vw,44px);}
.settings-page-heading .lede{font-size:12px;max-width:580px;}
.settings-save-state{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;white-space:nowrap;padding:9px 12px;margin-bottom:5px;border:1px solid rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.24);border-radius:6px;background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.045);color:var(--accent);font:8px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.6px;}
.settings-save-dot{width:7px;height:7px;display:inline-block;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.7);}
.settings-layout{width:min(1180px,100%);margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:206px minmax(0,1fr);align-items:start;gap:24px;}
.settings-local-nav{position:sticky;top:17px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:10px;border:1px solid #292929;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(17,17,17,.97),rgba(8,8,8,.97));box-shadow:0 9px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.2);}
.settings-nav-caption{padding:7px 9px 10px;color:#737373;font:7px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1.2px;}
.settings-nav-button{width:100%;min-height:43px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:#969696;text-align:left;font:11px var(--ui-pixel);transition:background .15s,border-color .15s,color .15s,transform .15s;}
.settings-nav-button:hover{background:#1a1a1a;border-color:#363636;color:#f0f0f0;}
.settings-nav-button.active{background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.095);border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.32);color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent);}
.settings-nav-icon{width:28px;height:28px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;border:1px solid #303030;border-radius:5px;background:#111;color:inherit;}
.settings-nav-icon svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
.settings-nav-button.active .settings-nav-icon{border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.34);background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.08);}
.settings-nav-label{flex:1;line-height:1.2;}
.settings-nav-chevron{font-size:18px;line-height:1;color:#626262;transform:translateY(-1px);}
.settings-nav-button.active .settings-nav-chevron{color:var(--accent);}
.settings-nav-separator{height:1px;margin:5px 3px;background:#292929;}
.settings-nav-button--advanced{color:#aa9999;}
.settings-nav-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:9px 4px 2px;padding:11px 6px 3px;border-top:1px solid #292929;color:#777;font-size:9px;line-height:1.4;}
.settings-nav-foot .settings-save-dot{width:6px;height:6px;}
.settings-content{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:25px;min-width:0;}
.settings-section{min-width:0;scroll-margin-top:19px;}
.settings-section-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;margin:0 0 10px;padding:0 2px;}
.settings-section-number{width:33px;height:33px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;border:1px solid rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.28);border-radius:6px;background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.06);color:var(--accent);font:9px var(--pixel);}
.settings-section-heading h2{margin:0 0 3px;color:#f1f1f1;font:16px var(--ui-pixel);}
.settings-section-heading p{margin:0;color:#818181;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;}
.settings-panel{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #2c2c2c;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(18,18,18,.98),rgba(11,11,11,.98));box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.17);}
.settings-panel:hover{border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.22);}
.settings-palette-option{padding:17px 19px 15px;}
.settings-option-copy{min-width:0;}
.settings-option-copy b{display:block;color:#e9e9e9;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35;}
.settings-option-copy small{display:block;max-width:560px;margin-top:4px;color:#818181;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;}
.settings-option-row{min-height:66px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding:12px 19px;border-top:1px solid #282828;}
.settings-option-control{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;flex:none;min-width:120px;}
.settings-option-row .switch{flex:none;}
.settings-option-row .engine-select{width:158px;max-width:100%;}
.settings-palette-option .accent-swatches{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin:13px 0 0;padding:0;}
.settings-palette-option .accent-swatch{width:31px;height:31px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45);}
.settings-palette-option .accent-swatch:hover{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.04);border-color:#fff;}
.settings-palette-option .accent-swatch.active{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0b0b0b,0 0 0 4px var(--swatch),0 0 15px color-mix(in srgb,var(--swatch),transparent 42%);}
.settings-palette-option .accent-swatch.active:after{inset:9px;border:1.5px solid #090909;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.8);border-radius:50%;}
.settings-current-accent{margin-top:11px;color:#666;font-size:9px;}
.settings-option-row--stacked{align-items:center;}
.settings-option-row--stacked .settings-option-control{width:min(340px,48%);}
.settings-option-control .range-control{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;margin:0;}
.settings-option-control .range-control input{width:100%;min-width:0;accent-color:var(--accent);}
.settings-option-control .range-control output{min-width:44px;text-align:right;color:var(--accent);font:8px var(--pixel);}
.settings-inline-note{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;padding:12px 19px;border-top:1px solid #282828;background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.025);color:#858585;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;}
.settings-inline-note svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex:none;fill:none;stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
.settings-panel--danger{border-color:rgba(190,105,112,.28);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(29,17,18,.72),rgba(13,11,11,.98));}
.settings-panel--danger .settings-option-copy b{color:#f0c4c6;}
.settings-panel--danger .settings-option-row{border-top:0;}
.settings-reset-card{display:block;}
.reset-settings-btn{padding:10px 13px;border:1px solid #80545a;border-radius:5px;background:#291719;color:#f0c1c4;font:8px var(--pixel);white-space:nowrap;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s,transform .15s;}
.reset-settings-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:#3a1e22;border-color:#c07b82;}
.settings-footer-note{width:min(1180px,100%);margin:22px auto 0;padding:12px 0 4px;border-top:1px solid #202020;color:#646464;font:8px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.8px;}
@media(max-width:850px){
 .settings-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:17px;}
 .settings-local-nav{position:static;display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:5px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding:7px;}
 .settings-local-nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
 .settings-nav-caption,.settings-nav-separator,.settings-nav-foot{display:none;}
 .settings-nav-button{width:auto;min-width:max-content;min-height:38px;padding:5px 9px;}
 .settings-nav-icon{width:25px;height:25px;}
 .settings-nav-chevron{display:none;}
 .settings-content{gap:21px;}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
 .settings-view{padding:19px 13px 35px;}
 .settings-page-heading{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:11px;margin-bottom:16px;}
 .settings-save-state{margin:0;}
 .settings-option-row{gap:12px;padding:12px 13px;}
 .settings-palette-option{padding:15px 13px;}
 .settings-option-row--stacked{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;}
 .settings-option-row--stacked .settings-option-control{width:100%;}
 .settings-option-row .engine-select{width:136px;}
 .settings-option-control{min-width:104px;}
 .settings-section-heading{gap:10px;}
 .settings-section-number{width:29px;height:29px;}
 .settings-panel--danger .settings-option-row{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;}
 .settings-panel--danger .settings-option-control{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start;}
 .settings-nav-button{font-size:10px;gap:7px;padding:5px 8px;}
 .settings-nav-label{max-width:105px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
}

/* Animated backdrop choices share the existing grid's vignette and accent glow. */
html[data-background="waves"] .workspace{
 background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 42%,rgba(0,0,0,.36) 100%),repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 110%,transparent 0 27px,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.11) 28px 29px,transparent 30px 53px),repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% -20%,transparent 0 38px,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.07) 39px 40px,transparent 41px 68px),radial-gradient(ellipse at 13% 18%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.08),transparent 29%);
 background-size:auto,150% 180%,160% 190%,auto;background-position:0 0,0% 0%,100% 100%,0 0;animation:settings-waves 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
html[data-background="circles"] .workspace{
 background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 40%,rgba(0,0,0,.38) 100%),repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,transparent 0 35px,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.10) 36px 37px,transparent 38px 70px),radial-gradient(ellipse at 13% 18%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.08),transparent 29%);
 background-size:auto,100% 140%,auto;background-position:0 0,50% 50%,0 0;animation:settings-circles 30s linear infinite;
}
html[data-background="dots"] .workspace{
 background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 44%,rgba(0,0,0,.36) 100%),radial-gradient(circle,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.28) 1px,transparent 1.8px),radial-gradient(circle,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12) 1px,transparent 1.8px),radial-gradient(ellipse at 13% 18%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.08),transparent 29%);
 background-size:auto,34px 34px,68px 68px,auto;background-position:0 0,0 0,17px 17px,0 0;animation:settings-dots 18s linear infinite;
}
html[data-background="fluid"] .workspace{
 background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 44%,rgba(0,0,0,.38) 100%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 18% 32%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.15),transparent 30%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 79% 68%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12),transparent 34%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 64% 13%,rgba(100,120,180,.09),transparent 30%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 13% 18%,rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.06),transparent 29%);
 background-size:auto,150% 150%,145% 150%,150% 140%,auto;background-position:0 0,0% 15%,100% 80%,50% 0%,0 0;animation:settings-fluid 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
html[data-background="image"] .workspace{
 background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 34%,rgba(0,0,0,.48) 100%),linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,.48),rgba(0,0,0,.48)),var(--custom-background-image);
 background-size:auto,auto,cover;background-position:center;background-repeat:no-repeat;
}
html[data-background="off"] .workspace{background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 44%,rgba(0,0,0,.38) 100%);}
html[data-motion="reduced"] .workspace{animation:none!important;}
html[data-motion="reduced"] .home-message--swap,html[data-motion="reduced"] .home-message--combo,html[data-motion="reduced"] .home-combo.is-visible,html[data-motion="reduced"] .secret-cat-svg,html[data-motion="reduced"] .secret-cat-tail,html[data-motion="reduced"] .secret-cat-eye,html[data-motion="reduced"] .secret-cat-bubble,html[data-motion="reduced"] .secret-cat-heart{animation:none!important;}
html[data-motion="reduced"] .secret-cat-explosion.is-firing{opacity:1!important;animation:none!important;}
@keyframes settings-waves{to{background-position:0 0,100% 25%,0% 75%,0 0}}
@keyframes settings-circles{to{background-position:0 0,50% 50%,0 0;background-size:auto,100% 180%,auto}}
@keyframes settings-dots{to{background-position:0 0,34px 34px,-17px -17px,0 0}}
@keyframes settings-fluid{to{background-position:0 0,100% 80%,0% 10%,20% 100%,0 0}}
.background-image-upload,.background-image-clear{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:32px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:4px;background:#151515;color:#eee;font:9px var(--ui-pixel);white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;}
.background-image-upload:hover,.background-image-clear:hover{border-color:#aaa;background:#202020;}
.background-image-file{display:none;}


/* Persistent build/version label. It stays in the lower-left without blocking input. */
.version-label{
  position:fixed;
  left:10px;
  bottom:9px;
  z-index:26;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:23px;
  padding:5px 7px;
  border:1px solid var(--accent-line,rgba(240,240,240,.62));
  border-radius:4px;
  background:rgba(5,5,5,.84);
  color:var(--accent,#f0f0f0);
  font:7px var(--pixel),monospace;
  letter-spacing:.35px;
  line-height:1.2;
  white-space:nowrap;
  opacity:.76;
  text-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent-glow,rgba(240,240,240,.28));
  box-shadow:0 2px 9px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  pointer-events:none;
  user-select:none;
  transition:left .18s ease,opacity .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,color .18s ease;
}
.version-label:hover{opacity:.9}
/* Keep the label clear of the proxy-tab rail when that rail is visible. */
.workspace.proxy-active:not(.left-hidden) ~ .version-label{
  left:calc(var(--tab-rail) + 9px);
}
@media(max-width:420px){
  .version-label{font-size:6px;padding:4px 6px;bottom:7px;}
  .workspace.proxy-active:not(.left-hidden) ~ .version-label{left:calc(var(--tab-rail) + 6px);}
}


/* Background preload indicator */
.preload-status{position:fixed;z-index:120;left:50%;bottom:16px;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;max-width:min(92vw,520px);padding:9px 13px;background:rgba(12,12,12,.94);border:1px solid var(--accent-line);border-radius:5px;color:var(--accent);font:10px/1.3 'Pixelify Sans',monospace;letter-spacing:.7px;box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45),0 0 14px var(--accent-glow-soft);pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.preload-status[hidden]{display:none}
.preload-status-dot{width:6px;height:6px;flex:0 0 6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 9px var(--accent);animation:preload-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite}
.preload-status.done .preload-status-dot{animation:none;opacity:.65}
@keyframes preload-pulse{50%{opacity:.28;transform:scale(.78)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.preload-status-dot{animation:none}}

/* Settings: full-width, divider-led layout inspired by the reference. */
.settings-view{padding:24px clamp(20px,3vw,48px) 44px;}
.settings-page-heading,.settings-layout,.settings-footer-note{width:100%;max-width:none;}
.settings-page-heading{margin:0 auto 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;}
.settings-heading-copy{min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;}
.settings-page-heading h1{order:1;margin:0;color:#f1f1f1;font:18px var(--ui-pixel);letter-spacing:.2px;}
.settings-heading-copy .eyebrow{order:2;color:#6f6f6f;font:8px var(--ui-pixel);letter-spacing:.4px;}
.settings-page-heading .lede{display:none;}
.settings-save-state{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin:0 0 0 auto;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.22);border-radius:5px;background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.045);color:var(--accent);font:7px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.6px;white-space:nowrap;}
.settings-save-dot{width:6px;height:6px;}
.settings-layout{display:block;margin:0 auto;}
.settings-local-nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:6;display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:0 0 20px;padding:6px;border:1px solid #282828;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(10,10,10,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.25);overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;}
.settings-local-nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.settings-nav-caption,.settings-nav-separator,.settings-nav-foot,.settings-nav-chevron{display:none;}
.settings-nav-button{width:auto;min-width:max-content;flex:none;min-height:32px;gap:7px;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:5px;color:#8f8f8f;font:9px var(--ui-pixel);}
.settings-nav-button:hover{background:#1c1c1c;border-color:#363636;color:#f0f0f0;}
.settings-nav-button.active{background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.09);border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.3);color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent);}
.settings-nav-icon{width:18px;height:18px;border:0;background:transparent;}
.settings-nav-icon svg{width:14px;height:14px;}
.settings-nav-button.active .settings-nav-icon{border-color:transparent;background:transparent;}
.settings-content{gap:21px;}
.settings-section{scroll-margin-top:62px;}
.settings-section-heading{margin:0 0 9px;padding:0 2px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #202020;}
.settings-section-number{display:none;}
.settings-section-heading h2{margin:0;color:#dcdcdc;font:9px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1.3px;text-transform:uppercase;}
.settings-section-heading p{display:none;}
.settings-panel{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #2c2c2c;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(18,18,18,.98),rgba(11,11,11,.98));box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.17);}
.settings-panel:hover{border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.22);}
.settings-panel--danger{border-color:rgba(190,105,112,.28);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(29,17,18,.72),rgba(13,11,11,.98));}
.settings-palette-option{min-height:70px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,1fr) auto;align-items:center;column-gap:24px;padding:12px 19px;border-top:0;}
.settings-palette-option .settings-option-copy{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;}
.settings-palette-option .accent-swatches{grid-column:2;grid-row:1 / span 2;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin:0;}
.settings-palette-option .accent-swatch{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);box-shadow:none;}
.settings-palette-option .accent-swatch.active{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #111,0 0 0 3px #fff;}
.settings-palette-option .accent-swatch.active:after{display:none;}
.settings-current-accent{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;margin-top:3px;font-size:9px;}
.settings-option-row{min-height:62px;gap:24px;padding:10px 19px;border-top:1px solid #282828;}
.settings-option-copy b{font-size:12px;color:#eee;}
.settings-option-copy small{margin-top:4px;font-size:10px;color:#858585;}
.settings-option-control{min-width:180px;}
.settings-option-row .engine-select{width:190px;}
.settings-option-row .switch{margin-right:0;}
.settings-inline-note{padding:10px 19px;border-top:1px solid #282828;background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.025);}
.settings-option-row--reset{border-top:0;}
.settings-footer-note{margin-top:23px;padding-top:12px;}
.settings-footer-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;margin-top:23px;padding:12px 0 4px;border-top:1px solid #202020;}
.settings-footer-row .settings-footer-note{flex:1;min-width:0;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;}

/* A small secret cat lives in the Settings footer. */
.secret-cat{position:relative;flex:none;width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:transparent;color:#5f5f5f;cursor:pointer;opacity:.42;transition:opacity .18s,color .18s,background .18s,transform .18s}
.secret-cat:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--accent);background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.07)}
.secret-cat:focus-visible{opacity:1;outline:1px dashed var(--accent-line);outline-offset:2px}
.secret-cat-svg{width:30px;height:30px;display:block;overflow:visible}
.secret-cat-body,.secret-cat-head{fill:currentColor}
.secret-cat-tail{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;transform-origin:28px 29px;animation:secret-cat-tail 2.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.secret-cat-eye{fill:#0a0a0a;animation:secret-cat-blink 4.6s infinite}
.secret-cat-nose{fill:#0a0a0a;opacity:.7}
.secret-cat-bubble{position:absolute;right:2px;bottom:calc(100% - 2px);padding:4px 7px;border:1px solid var(--accent-line);border-radius:6px;background:#161616;color:var(--accent);font:8px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.6px;white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px) scale(.9);pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.secret-cat.is-playing{opacity:1;color:var(--accent)}
.secret-cat.is-playing .secret-cat-svg{animation:secret-cat-hop 2.6s cubic-bezier(.3,.9,.3,1) both}
.secret-cat.is-playing .secret-cat-bubble{animation:secret-cat-bubble 2.4s ease both}
.secret-cat-hearts{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.secret-cat-heart{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:60%;color:var(--accent);font-size:var(--heart-size,11px);line-height:1;opacity:0;text-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);animation:secret-cat-heart 1.5s ease-out var(--heart-delay,0ms) both}
.secret-cat-explosion{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-40px;width:104px;height:auto;max-width:none;transform:translate(-50%,0);pointer-events:none;z-index:4;opacity:0;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(255,120,50,.55))}
.secret-cat-explosion[hidden]{display:none}
.secret-cat-explosion.is-firing{animation:secret-cat-explosion 1.7s ease-out both}
.secret-cat.is-charging{opacity:1;color:#ff5a5f;background:rgba(255,90,95,.08)}
.secret-cat.is-charging .secret-cat-svg{animation:secret-cat-charge 1.8s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97) both}
.secret-cat.is-charging .secret-cat-bubble{opacity:1;transform:none;border-color:rgba(255,120,120,.6);color:#ff9a9e}
.secret-cat.is-charging:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:1px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,90,95,.35),0 0 18px 4px rgba(255,90,95,.28);animation:secret-cat-charge-glow 1.8s ease-in both}
.secret-cat.is-exploded{opacity:1}
.secret-cat.is-exploded .secret-cat-svg{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.45);transition:opacity .06s linear,transform .06s linear}
.secret-cat.is-exploded .secret-cat-tail,.secret-cat.is-exploded .secret-cat-eye{animation:none}
.secret-cat.is-exploded .secret-cat-bubble{opacity:0}
.secret-cat.is-respawning .secret-cat-svg{animation:secret-cat-respawn .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1) both}
.secret-cat.is-respawning .secret-cat-bubble{opacity:1;transform:none}
.secret-cat-particle{position:absolute;left:50%;top:52%;width:var(--p-size,3px);height:var(--p-size,3px);border-radius:50%;background:#ffb52e;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,150,50,.9);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;animation:secret-cat-converge 1s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.3,1) var(--p-delay,0ms) both}
.settings-footer-row.is-shaking{animation:secret-cat-quake .6s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97) both}
@keyframes secret-cat-charge{0%{transform:translate(0,0) rotate(0) scale(1)}10%{transform:translate(-1px,0) rotate(-2deg) scale(1.02)}20%{transform:translate(1px,0) rotate(2deg) scale(1.04)}30%{transform:translate(-2px,1px) rotate(-3deg) scale(1.06)}40%{transform:translate(2px,-1px) rotate(3deg) scale(1.09)}50%{transform:translate(-3px,1px) rotate(-4deg) scale(1.12)}60%{transform:translate(3px,-1px) rotate(4deg) scale(1.16)}70%{transform:translate(-4px,2px) rotate(-5deg) scale(1.2)}80%{transform:translate(4px,-2px) rotate(5deg) scale(1.26)}90%{transform:translate(-5px,2px) rotate(-6deg) scale(1.32)}100%{transform:translate(0,0) rotate(0) scale(1.4)}}
@keyframes secret-cat-charge-glow{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.7)}60%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.35)}}
@keyframes secret-cat-converge{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translate(var(--p-x,0),var(--p-y,0)) scale(.4)}15%{opacity:1}70%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.05)}}
@keyframes secret-cat-explosion{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,12px) scale(.35)}8%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(1.18)}18%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(1)}72%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-6px) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-14px) scale(1.03)}}
@keyframes secret-cat-quake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}10%{transform:translate(-2px,1px)}20%{transform:translate(2px,-1px)}30%{transform:translate(-3px,2px)}40%{transform:translate(3px,-2px)}50%{transform:translate(-2px,1px)}60%{transform:translate(2px,-1px)}70%{transform:translate(-1px,1px)}80%{transform:translate(1px,-1px)}}
@keyframes secret-cat-respawn{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.2)}60%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.14)}100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
@keyframes secret-cat-tail{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}50%{transform:rotate(13deg)}}
@keyframes secret-cat-blink{0%,92%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}95%{transform:scaleY(.15)}}
