@keyframes secret-cat-hop{0%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}12%{transform:translateY(2px) scale(1.08,.9)}28%{transform:translateY(-9px) scale(.94,1.08)}42%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1.1,.9)}56%{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1)}70%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes secret-cat-bubble{0%,8%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(5px) scale(.85)}16%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1.05)}24%,72%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-5px) scale(.98)}}
@keyframes secret-cat-heart{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(.6)}18%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--heart-x,0px)),-34px) scale(1.1) rotate(8deg)}}
@media(max-width:700px){
 .settings-view{padding:18px 15px 36px;}
 .settings-page-heading{gap:10px;margin-bottom:11px;}
 .settings-heading-copy{gap:7px;}
 .settings-page-heading h1{font-size:16px;}
 .settings-save-state{padding:5px 7px;font-size:7px;}
 .settings-local-nav{margin-bottom:15px;}
 .settings-palette-option{grid-template-columns:1fr;row-gap:10px;padding:14px 13px;}
 .settings-palette-option .settings-option-copy,.settings-palette-option .accent-swatches,.settings-current-accent{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto;}
 .settings-palette-option .accent-swatches{justify-content:flex-start;}
 .settings-option-control{min-width:130px;}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
 .settings-page-heading{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
 .settings-heading-copy .eyebrow{font-size:7px;}
 .settings-save-state{margin-left:auto;padding:4px 6px;font-size:6px;}
 .settings-nav-button{min-height:30px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:8px;}
 .settings-section{scroll-margin-top:56px;}
 .settings-option-row{gap:12px;padding:12px 13px;}
 .settings-inline-note{padding:12px 13px;}
 .settings-option-row .engine-select{width:145px;}
 .settings-option-control{min-width:100px;}
 .settings-option-row--stacked{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;}
 .settings-option-row--stacked .settings-option-control{width:100%;}
 .settings-panel--danger .settings-option-row{align-items:center;flex-direction:row;}
 .settings-panel--danger .settings-option-control{width:auto;justify-content:flex-end;}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 .secret-cat-explosion.is-firing{opacity:1!important;animation:none!important;}
}

/* COMMAND PALETTE: a Ctrl/Cmd+K launcher for pages, actions, tabs, and games. */
.command-hint{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:15px;padding:6px 11px;border:1px solid #323232;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(10,10,10,.72);color:#8b8b8b;font:8px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1.3px;line-height:1;transition:color .16s,border-color .16s,background .16s,transform .16s,box-shadow .16s}
.command-hint:hover{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent-line);background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.07);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.command-hint:focus-visible{outline:1px dashed var(--accent-line);outline-offset:3px}
.command-hint-key{padding:3px 5px;border:1px solid #3d3d3d;border-radius:3px;background:#171717;color:#c9c9c9;font:7px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.6px}
.command-palette{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:min(13vh,116px) 16px 16px}
.command-palette[hidden]{display:none!important}
.command-backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);animation:command-fade .16s ease both}
.command-dialog{position:relative;width:min(640px,100%);max-height:min(64vh,580px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #3a3a3a;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#151515,#0a0a0a);box-shadow:0 26px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.66),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.03),0 0 44px var(--accent-glow-soft);animation:command-pop .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1) both}
.command-search-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:13px 15px;border-bottom:1px solid #262626}
.command-search-icon{width:19px;height:19px;color:#8f8f8f}
.command-input{flex:1;min-width:0;height:30px;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;color:#f4f4f4;font:15px var(--ui-pixel),monospace}
.command-input::placeholder{color:#6f6f6f}
.command-key{flex:none;padding:4px 6px;border:1px solid #3d3d3d;border-radius:4px;background:#171717;color:#9a9a9a;font:7px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.6px}
.command-results{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;padding:7px 7px 9px;scrollbar-color:#555 #111;scrollbar-width:thin}
.command-group{margin:8px 0 3px;padding:0 10px;color:#707070;font:8px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1.5px}
.command-group:first-child{margin-top:3px}
.command-item{width:100%;min-height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:#dcdcdc;text-align:left;font-size:13px;line-height:1.2;transition:background .1s,border-color .1s,color .1s}
.command-item:hover,.command-item.is-selected{border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.34);background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.09);color:#fff}
.command-item.is-selected{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.14)}
.command-item-icon{flex:none;width:26px;height:26px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #383838;border-radius:6px;background:#181818;color:var(--accent)}
.command-item-icon .icon{width:15px;height:15px}
.command-item-copy{min-width:0;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.command-item-label{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.command-item-label mark{background:transparent;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
.command-item-meta{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:#747474;font:9px var(--ui-pixel);letter-spacing:.5px}
.command-item-hint{flex:none;color:#6c6c6c;font:7px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:.5px}
.command-empty{padding:28px 16px;text-align:center;color:#8a8a8a;font:10px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1px;line-height:1.9}
.command-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:8px 13px;border-top:1px solid #262626;background:#090909}
.command-footer-title{color:#7a7a7a;font:7px var(--pixel);letter-spacing:1.4px}
.command-footer-hints{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:#787878;font:9px var(--ui-pixel)}
.command-footer-hints kbd{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:16px;height:16px;padding:0 3px;border:1px solid #383838;border-radius:3px;background:#161616;color:#b5b5b5;font:8px var(--pixel)}
@keyframes command-fade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes command-pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-9px) scale(.985)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(max-width:560px){.command-palette{padding:9vh 10px 10px}.command-dialog{max-height:78vh}.command-footer-hints{display:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.command-backdrop,.command-dialog{animation:none}}

/* ===== HOMEWORKBOT =====
   Chat-style thread: quiet top bar, centered conversation, rounded composer.
   Normal mode stays short; Study mode explains more and can quiz. */
.homework-view{max-width:none;padding:0}
.homework-view.active{display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;min-height:0}
.homework-wrap{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}

.studi-topbar{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:10px clamp(14px,3vw,26px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);background:rgba(9,9,9,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.studi-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-width:0}
.studi-brand-icon{flex:none;width:24px;height:24px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.22);border-radius:7px;background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.09);color:var(--accent)}
.studi-brand-icon svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.studi-brand-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2px;color:#f0f0f0;white-space:nowrap}
.studi-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:2px 8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);color:#8c8c8c;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2px;white-space:nowrap;transition:border-color .15s,color .15s,background .15s}
.studi-badge-dot{width:5px;height:5px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:#6d6d6d}
.studi-badge small{font:inherit}
.studi-badge.is-online{border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.32);background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.08);color:var(--accent)}
.studi-badge.is-online .studi-badge-dot{background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 7px var(--accent)}

.studi-modes{flex:none;display:flex;gap:2px;padding:2px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.045)}
.studi-mode{padding:5px 13px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:#8e8e8e;font:11.5px var(--ui-pixel),sans-serif;letter-spacing:.2px;transition:background .15s,color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.studi-mode:hover{color:#dedede}
.studi-mode.is-active{background:#2b2b2b;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}

.studi-thread{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
.studi-log{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;padding:28px clamp(16px,3.4vw,30px) 20px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#3a3a3a transparent;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.studi-log::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px}
.studi-log::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#333;border-radius:8px}
.studi-log::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:#444}

.studi-msg{display:flex;width:100%;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;animation:studi-in .18s ease both}
.studi-msg--user{justify-content:flex-end}
.studi-msg-body{min-width:0;max-width:100%;color:#e6e6e6;font-size:14px;line-height:1.72;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.studi-msg--bot .studi-msg-body{width:100%}
.studi-msg--user .studi-msg-body{max-width:min(78%,540px);padding:10px 15px;border-radius:18px;border-bottom-right-radius:6px;background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12);color:#f7f7f7}
.studi-msg-body p{margin:0 0 10px}
.studi-msg-body p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.studi-msg-body ol,.studi-msg-body ul{margin:8px 0 10px;padding-left:20px}
.studi-msg-body li{margin:4px 0}
.studi-msg-body b,.studi-msg-body strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.studi-msg-body code{padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:var(--accent);font:12px "Lucida Console",monospace}
.studi-msg-body .studi-answer{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.studi-msg-image{display:block;max-width:230px;max-height:170px;margin-top:10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:12px;object-fit:cover}
.studi-typing{display:inline-flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;height:18px}
.studi-typing i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#bdbdbd;opacity:.35;animation:studi-typing 1s infinite}
.studi-typing i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}
.studi-typing i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s}
.studi-reveal{margin:4px 0 6px;padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:#e8e8e8;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.3px;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s}
.studi-reveal:hover{border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.45);background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.1);color:var(--accent)}
.studi-note{color:#8b8b8b;font-size:12px}

.studi-welcome{margin:auto;width:100%;max-width:600px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:12px 0 26px;text-align:center;animation:studi-in .26s ease both}
.studi-welcome-mark{width:46px;height:46px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px;border:1px solid rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.2);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.09);color:var(--accent)}
.studi-welcome-mark svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.studi-welcome h2{margin:0 0 8px;color:#f2f2f2;font-size:clamp(19px,2.6vw,25px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.3px}
.studi-welcome p{margin:0 0 22px;max-width:440px;color:#8d8d8d;font-size:13px;line-height:1.65}
.studi-prompts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;width:100%}
.studi-prompt{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;padding:12px 13px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);text-align:left;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s,transform .15s}
.studi-prompt:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.24);background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.studi-prompt-icon{flex:none;width:23px;height:23px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:7px;background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.08);color:var(--accent);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:1}
.studi-prompt-text{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.studi-prompt-text b{color:#eaeaea;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.studi-prompt-text small{color:#8a8a8a;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.45}

.studi-dock{flex:none;padding:6px clamp(14px,3.4vw,30px) 14px;background:#090909}
.studi-composer{width:min(760px,100%);margin:0 auto;padding:9px 9px 8px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:22px;background:#141414;box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.32);transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.studi-composer:focus-within{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.38),0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.05)}
.studi-composer-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px}
.studi-attach{flex:none;width:32px;height:32px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);border-radius:50%;background:transparent;color:#b0b0b0;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s,color .15s}
.studi-attach:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#fff}
.studi-attach svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.studi-file{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.studi-input{flex:1;min-width:0;max-height:200px;padding:6px 2px;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;color:#f2f2f2;font:14px var(--ui-pixel),sans-serif;line-height:1.55;resize:none;overflow-y:auto}
.studi-input::placeholder{color:#6b6b6b}
.studi-model{position:relative;flex:none}
.studi-model-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:32px;max-width:170px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:#a6a6a6;font:11px var(--ui-pixel),sans-serif;letter-spacing:.2px;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s,color .15s}
.studi-model-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.26);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#eaeaea}
.studi-model-btn[aria-expanded="true"]{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff}
.studi-model-btn:focus-visible,.studi-model-option:focus-visible{outline:1px solid rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.55);outline-offset:2px}
.studi-model-dot{width:5px;height:5px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:#777}
.studi-model-btn.is-connected .studi-model-dot{background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--accent)}
.studi-model-label{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.studi-model-btn svg{width:11px;height:11px;flex:none;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;opacity:.65}
.studi-model-menu{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:calc(100% + 9px);z-index:20;width:248px;padding:5px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:14px;background:#1b1b1b;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55);animation:studi-in .14s ease both}
.studi-model-option{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;width:100%;padding:9px 10px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:transparent;color:#dedede;text-align:left;transition:background .13s}
.studi-model-option:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.studi-model-option.is-selected{background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.08)}
.studi-model-option:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.45}
.studi-model-check{flex:none;width:13px;color:var(--accent);font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;visibility:hidden}
.studi-model-option.is-selected .studi-model-check{visibility:visible}
.studi-model-copy{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px}
.studi-model-copy b{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:#f0f0f0;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.studi-model-copy small{color:#8a8a8a;font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.4}
.studi-send{flex:none;width:32px;height:32px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:#0b0b0b;transition:background .15s,color .15s,transform .12s,opacity .15s}
.studi-send:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(-1px)}
.studi-send:disabled{background:#2b2b2b;color:#6a6a6a;cursor:not-allowed}
.studi-send svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.studi-attachment{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;padding:5px 8px 5px 5px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.studi-attachment img{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;object-fit:cover}
.studi-attachment span{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:#a5a5a5;font-size:11.5px}
.studi-attachment-remove{flex:none;width:22px;height:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#cfcfcf;font-size:14px;line-height:1}
.studi-attachment-remove:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:#fff}
.studi-footnote{margin:9px auto 0;max-width:760px;color:#636363;font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.55;text-align:center}
.studi-footnote #studi-engine-note{color:#858585}

.settings-field-control{flex:1;justify-content:flex-end;min-width:0}
.settings-text-input{width:min(330px,100%);padding:7px 9px;border:1px solid #333;border-radius:5px;background:#0d0d0d;color:#ededed;font:12px var(--ui-pixel),monospace;outline:0}
.settings-text-input:focus{border-color:var(--accent-line,rgba(240,240,240,.6));box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.14)}
.settings-text-input::placeholder{color:#5f5f5f}

@keyframes studi-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes studi-typing{0%,60%,100%{opacity:.3;transform:translateY(0)}30%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-2px)}}

@media(max-width:640px){
  .studi-brand-name{display:none}
  .studi-topbar{padding:9px 12px}
  .studi-log{padding:20px 14px 16px;gap:16px}
  .studi-dock{padding:6px 12px 12px}
  .studi-prompts{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .studi-welcome p{font-size:12.5px}
  .studi-msg--user .studi-msg-body{max-width:88%}
  .studi-model-btn{max-width:118px;padding:0 8px}
  .studi-model-menu{width:min(240px,calc(100vw - 44px))}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .studi-msg,.studi-welcome,.studi-model-menu{animation:none}
  .studi-typing i{animation:none;opacity:.7}
  .studi-prompt:hover{transform:none}
  .studi-send:hover:not(:disabled){transform:none}
}

/* =====================================================================
   SILVERITE IDENTITY REFRESH
   A distinct navy/teal arcade look that replaces the old pixel-browser skin.
   ===================================================================== */
:root{
  --bg:#070b16;--panel:#101a30;--panel2:#16223c;--line:#28375a;--line2:#3d5480;
  --white:#eaf1ff;--muted:#9aa9c8;
  --accent:#5ee6c8;--accent-rgb:94,230,200;--orange:var(--accent);
  --accent-tint:rgba(94,230,200,.13);--accent-tint-strong:rgba(94,230,200,.22);
  --accent-line:rgba(94,230,200,.62);--accent-glow:rgba(94,230,200,.28);--accent-glow-soft:rgba(94,230,200,.14);
  --sans:"Segoe UI",Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;
  --display:"Segoe UI",Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;
  --pixel:var(--display);--ui-pixel:var(--sans);
}
html,body{font-family:var(--sans)}
body{background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 12% 10%,rgba(94,230,200,.13),transparent 34%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 82% 82%,rgba(90,168,255,.12),transparent 38%),linear-gradient(160deg,#070b16,#0a1020 60%,#080d1a)}

/* Text wordmark replaces the old logo images. */
.loader-brand::before,.brand-logo::before,.g4m3s-brand::before{
  content:"SILVERITE";display:block;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;text-align:center;
  font:800 clamp(34px,6.2vw,68px)/1 var(--display);letter-spacing:.22em;text-indent:.22em;
  background:linear-gradient(115deg,#7bf1d5 0%,#7aa8ff 56%,#c39bff 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.5));
}
.loader-brand{margin-bottom:30px}
.loader-logo,.brand-logo img,.g4m3s-brand img{display:none!important}
.brand-logo,.g4m3s-brand{line-height:1!important}
.brand-logo{width:min(580px,90vw);margin-bottom:34px}
.g4m3s-brand{width:min(420px,82vw);margin:0 auto 26px}

.browser-top{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0a1224,#0d1830);border-bottom-color:var(--line)}
.address{font-family:var(--sans);border-color:var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:#0a1122}
.address:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.left-rail,.right-rail{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a1122,#0d1730);border-color:var(--line)}
.rail-btn{border-radius:12px;border-color:transparent;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.rail-btn.active{background:var(--accent-tint-strong);border-color:var(--accent-line);color:var(--accent)}

.view{scrollbar-color:var(--line2) #0a1122}
.home-view{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,rgba(94,230,200,.08),transparent 55%)}
.home-center{width:min(720px,100%)}
.home-search-row{max-width:640px}
.home-search{border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(9,15,30,.88);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:14px}
.home-search:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12)}
.home-message{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:none}
.social-btn{border-radius:12px;border-color:var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.command-hint{border-radius:12px;border-color:var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);font-family:var(--sans)}

.g4m3s-search-wrap{max-width:680px}
.g4m3s-search{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(9,15,30,.92);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:14px;font-weight:400}
.g4m3s-search::placeholder{color:#7f8daa}
.game-count{font:700 12px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;text-shadow:none}
.library-filter-btn{border-radius:13px;border-color:var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.library-filter-btn.active{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-tint-strong);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12)}
.library-filter-label,.library-filter-fallback{font-family:var(--sans)}

.game-grid{gap:18px}
.game-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel2),var(--panel));box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.game-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent-line);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 0 22px var(--accent-glow-soft)}
.game-art{height:150px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px 15px 0 0}
.game-art:before,.game-art:after,.game-art.has-thumb:before,.game-art.has-thumb:after{display:none!important}
.art-glyph{font-family:var(--display);font-size:44px;text-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transform:none}
.game-name{height:38px;background:transparent;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font:600 13px var(--sans)}
.game-source{height:20px;border:0;background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.08);color:var(--accent);font:700 8px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
.play-btn{width:calc(100% - 12px);margin:6px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--accent),#5aa8ff);color:#04121d;font:700 12px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:none}
.play-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.24)}
.empty{border-radius:14px;border-color:var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);font-family:var(--sans)}

.player-shell{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.38)}
.player-control{border-radius:11px;border-color:var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.player-control:hover{border-color:var(--accent-line);background:var(--accent-tint)}
.player-footer{background:#0b1428;border-color:var(--line);font-family:var(--sans)}
.player-title-wrap h1{font-family:var(--display);letter-spacing:-1px}

h1,.lede{font-family:var(--display)}
.eyebrow{font:700 10px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.22em}
.panel,.settings-card,.credit-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(17,27,49,.95),rgba(9,15,29,.96));box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.credit-card--lead{border-color:var(--accent-line)}
.credit-kicker,.settings-kicker{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em}
.credit-card h2{font-family:var(--display)}
.credit-providers b{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px}
.settings-section-number,.field-label{font-family:var(--sans)}
.toast{border-radius:12px;border-color:var(--line);background:#0d1730;font-family:var(--sans)}
.command-dialog{border-radius:16px;border-color:var(--line);background:#0d1730}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="silverite-loader" role="status" aria-live="polite">
  <div class="loader-inner">
    <div class="loader-brand"><img src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/braydensrandomcreations/silverite@main/assets/silverite-logo.png" alt="Silverite" class="loader-logo"></div>
    <div class="loader-status" id="loader-status">loading.. 0/5</div>
    <div class="loader-file" id="loader-file">Starting Silverite</div>
    <div class="loader-track"><div class="loader-fill" id="loader-fill"></div></div>
    <div class="loader-hint">INITIALIZING INTERFACE</div>
  </div>
</div>

<header class="browser-top" aria-label="Browser controls">
  <button class="browser-btn" id="toggle-left" title="Toggle sidebar" aria-label="Toggle sidebar"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" ><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M9 4v16M6 8h1M6 11h1"/></svg></button>
  <button class="browser-btn" id="back-btn" title="Back" aria-label="Back"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" ><path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"/></svg></button>
  <button class="browser-btn" id="forward-btn" title="Forward" aria-label="Forward"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" ><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"/></svg></button>
  <button class="browser-btn" id="reload-btn" title="Reload" aria-label="Reload"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" ><path d="M20 11a8 8 0 0 0-14.8-4L3 10"/><path d="M3 4v6h6M4 13a8 8 0 0 0 14.8 4L21 14"/><path d="M21 20v-6h-6"/></svg></button>
  <form class="address-wrap" id="address-form"><input class="address" id="address-bar" placeholder="Enter a URL or search the web" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></form>
</header>
<div class="workspace">
  <aside class="left-rail" id="left-rail" aria-label="Proxy tabs">
    <button class="rail-btn" id="new-proxy-tab" title="New tab" aria-label="New tab">
      <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>
    </button>
    <div class="proxy-tab-list" id="proxy-tab-list" role="tablist" aria-label="Open proxy tabs">
      <div class="proxy-tab-item">
        <button class="rail-btn proxy-tab active" type="button" data-proxy-tab="1" role="tab" aria-selected="true" title="New Tab" aria-label="New Tab">
          <img class="tab-favicon" alt="" hidden referrerpolicy="no-referrer">
          <svg class="icon tab-default-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><ellipse cx="12" cy="12" rx="4.5" ry="9"/><path d="M3 12h18"/></svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </aside>
  <main class="stage" id="stage">

    <section class="view g4m3s-view" id="view-g4m3s">
      <div class="g4m3s-brand"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Silverite"></div>
      
      <nav class="library-filter-bar" id="library-filter-bar" aria-label="Filter games by library"></nav>

      <form class="g4m3s-search-wrap" id="g4m3s-search-form">
        <input class="g4m3s-search" id="game-search" placeholder="Search games..." autocomplete="off">
        <span class="g4m3s-search-icon"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" ><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-4-4"/></svg></span>
      </form>

      <div class="game-count" id="game-count">GAMES</div>
      <div class="game-grid" id="game-grid"></div>
    </section>

    <section class="view player-view" id="view-player">
      <div class="player-heading">
        <div class="player-info-bottom">
          <div class="player-title-wrap">
            <div class="eyebrow">NOW PLAYING</div>
            <h1 id="player-title">Game Slot</h1>
            <div class="player-meta"><span id="player-status">SLOT READY</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="player-toolbar" aria-label="Game controls">
          <button class="player-control close-control" id="close-game" title="Close game" aria-label="Close game"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button>
          <button class="player-control" id="reload-game" title="Reload game" aria-label="Reload game"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 11a8 8 0 0 0-14.8-4L3 10"/><path d="M3 4v6h6M4 13a8 8 0 0 0 14.8 4L21 14"/><path d="M21 20v-6h-6"/></svg></button>
          <button class="player-control" id="copy-game" title="Copy game link" aria-label="Copy game link"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="8" y="8" width="12" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M16 8V5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v10a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h3"/></svg></button>
          <button class="player-control" id="favorite-game" title="Add to favorites" aria-label="Add to favorites"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20.8 8.8c0 5.1-8.8 10.2-8.8 10.2S3.2 13.9 3.2 8.8A4.8 4.8 0 0 1 12 6.1a4.8 4.8 0 0 1 8.8 2.7Z"/></svg></button>
          <button class="player-control" id="newtab-game" title="Open in new tab" aria-label="Open in new tab"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M14 4h6v6M20 4l-9 9"/><path d="M18 13v5a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h5"/></svg></button>
          <button class="player-control fullscreen-control" id="fullscreen-game" title="Fullscreen" aria-label="Fullscreen"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v3M16 3h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v3M21 16v3a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-3M3 16v3a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h3"/></svg></button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="player-shell" id="player-shell">
        <div class="player-screen" id="player-screen">
          <iframe id="game-frame" title="Game window" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-pointer-lock allow-downloads allow-modals" allow="fullscreen; autoplay; gamepad" allowfullscreen referrerpolicy="no-referrer" hidden></iframe>
          <div class="player-empty" id="player-empty">
            <div class="player-empty-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7.1 7.25h9.8a4.75 4.75 0 0 1 4.63 5.8l-1.02 4.2a2.65 2.65 0 0 1-4.32 1.45L13.1 16h-2.2l-3.09 2.7a2.65 2.65 0 0 1-4.32-1.45l-1.02-4.2a4.75 4.75 0 0 1 4.63-5.8Z"/><path d="M7.2 10.5v4.2M5.1 12.6h4.2M16.2 11.6h.01M18.25 14h.01"/></svg></div>
            <div class="player-empty-kicker">SILVERITE GAME PLAYER</div>
            <h2 id="player-empty-title">GAME UNAVAILABLE</h2>
            <p>This game could not be loaded. Check your connection or try opening it in a new tab.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="player-footer"><span>ESC <b>BACK TO GAMES</b></span><span id="player-footer-name">SILVERITE PLAYER</span></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="view home-view active" id="view-proxy">
      <div class="clock" id="clock">--:--</div>
      <div class="home-center">
        <div class="brand-logo"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Silverite" width="480" height="90"></div>
        <form class="home-search-row" id="proxy-home-search-form">
          <input class="home-search" id="proxy-home-search" placeholder="Search with DuckDuckGo or enter a URL" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
          <button class="search-submit" type="submit" aria-label="Search">
            <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-4-4"/></svg>
          </button>
        </form>
        <p class="home-message" id="home-message" role="button" tabindex="0" title="Click for another message" aria-live="polite"></p>
        <span class="home-combo" id="home-combo" aria-live="polite"></span>
        <div class="social-row">
          <button class="social-btn" data-proxy-url="https://www.tiktok.com" title="TikTok"><svg class="icon brand-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path fill="currentColor" stroke="none" d="M19.7 8.1a7.3 7.3 0 0 1-4.5-1.6v7.1a5.6 5.6 0 1 1-5.6-5.6c.4 0 .8 0 1.2.1v3.1a2.6 2.6 0 1 0 1.8 2.4V2.5h3a4.6 4.6 0 0 0 4.1 4.2v1.4Z"/></svg></button>
          <button class="social-btn" data-proxy-url="https://www.youtube.com" title="YouTube"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" ><rect x="2.5" y="5" width="19" height="14" rx="4"/><path d="m10 9 5 3-5 3V9Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg></button>
          <button class="social-btn" data-proxy-url="https://discord.com" title="Discord" aria-label="Discord"><svg class="icon brand-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path fill="currentColor" stroke="none" d="M19.73 5.23A18.6 18.6 0 0 0 15.2 3.8l-.57 1.16a16.2 16.2 0 0 0-5.26 0L8.8 3.8a18.6 18.6 0 0 0-4.53 1.43C1.4 9.53.63 13.52 1.02 17.45a18.8 18.8 0 0 0 5.56 2.8l1.2-1.96a12.1 12.1 0 0 1-1.89-.91l.46-.36a13.3 13.3 0 0 0 11.3 0l.46.36a12.1 12.1 0 0 1-1.89.91l1.2 1.96a18.8 18.8 0 0 0 5.56-2.8c.46-4.56-.78-8.52-3.25-12.22ZM8.6 14.97c-1.1 0-2-.99-2-2.2s.88-2.2 2-2.2 2.02.99 2 2.2c0 1.21-.89 2.2-2 2.2Zm6.8 0c-1.1 0-2-.99-2-2.2s.88-2.2 2-2.2 2.02.99 2 2.2c0 1.21-.88 2.2-2 2.2Z"/></svg></button>
        </div>
        <button class="command-hint" id="command-hint" type="button" title="Open the command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K)" aria-label="Open the command palette">
          <span class="command-hint-key" id="command-hint-key">CTRL K</span>
          <span>COMMAND PALETTE</span>
        </button>
      </div>
      <div class="proxy-frame-container" id="proxy-frame-container" aria-label="Proxied pages"></div>
      <div class="proxy-loading" id="proxy-loading" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden>
        <span class="proxy-loading-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="proxy-loading-label">Loading page</span>
      </div>
      <aside class="proxy-diagnostics" id="proxy-diagnostics" hidden aria-label="Read-only proxy diagnostics">
        <div class="proxy-diagnostics-header"><strong>PROXY DIAGNOSTICS <span>READ ONLY</span></strong><button type="button" id="close-diagnostics" aria-label="Close diagnostics">×</button></div>
        <pre id="diagnostics-output" role="log" aria-live="off">No diagnostics captured yet.</pre>
      </aside>
    </section>

    <section class="view standard-view settings-view" id="view-settings">
      <div class="settings-page-heading">
        <div class="settings-heading-copy">
          <div class="eyebrow">Version 0.12.11.3.2</div>
          <h1>Settings.</h1>
          <p class="lede">All of your Silverite preferences, clearly organized in one place.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="settings-save-state"><span class="settings-save-dot"></span><span>AUTO-SAVED</span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="settings-layout">
        <nav class="settings-local-nav" aria-label="Settings sections">
          <div class="settings-nav-caption">SETTINGS MENU</div>
          <button class="settings-nav-button active" type="button" data-settings-target="appearance" aria-current="true">
            <span class="settings-nav-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3a9 9 0 1 0 0 18h1.2a2.3 2.3 0 0 0 1.5-4c-.6-.5-.2-1.5.6-1.5H17a4 4 0 0 0 4-4c0-4.7-4-8.5-9-8.5Z"/><circle cx="7.5" cy="10" r="1"/><circle cx="11" cy="7" r="1"/><circle cx="15" cy="8" r="1"/></svg></span>
            <span class="settings-nav-label">Appearance</span><span class="settings-nav-chevron">›</span>
          </button>
          <button class="settings-nav-button" type="button" data-settings-target="interface" aria-current="false">
            <span class="settings-nav-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4"/></svg></span>
            <span class="settings-nav-label">Interface</span><span class="settings-nav-chevron">›</span>
          </button>
          <button class="settings-nav-button" type="button" data-settings-target="proxy" aria-current="false">
            <span class="settings-nav-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 3a15 15 0 0 1 0 18M12 3a15 15 0 0 0 0 18"/></svg></span>
            <span class="settings-nav-label">Proxy</span><span class="settings-nav-chevron">›</span>
          </button>
          <button class="settings-nav-button" type="button" data-settings-target="homeworkbot" aria-current="false">
            <span class="settings-nav-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9.2 18h5.6M10.3 21h3.4M12 3a6 6 0 0 0-3.6 10.8c.7.5 1.1 1.3 1.1 2.2h5c0-.9.4-1.7 1.1-2.2A6 6 0 0 0 12 3Z"/></svg></span>
            <span class="settings-nav-label">HomeworkBot</span><span class="settings-nav-chevron">›</span>
          </button>
          <div class="settings-nav-separator"></div>
          <button class="settings-nav-button settings-nav-button--advanced" type="button" data-settings-target="advanced" aria-current="false">
            <span class="settings-nav-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 2.6-6.4L3 8"/><path d="M3 3v5h5M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg></span>
            <span class="settings-nav-label">Advanced</span><span class="settings-nav-chevron">›</span>
          </button>
          <div class="settings-nav-foot"><span class="settings-save-dot"></span> Changes save automatically</div>
        </nav>

        <div class="settings-content">
          <section class="settings-section" id="settings-appearance" aria-labelledby="settings-appearance-title">
            <div class="settings-section-heading"><span class="settings-section-number">01</span><div><h2 id="settings-appearance-title">Appearance</h2><p>Set the visual style of Silverite.</p></div></div>
            <div class="settings-panel">
              <div class="settings-palette-option">
                <div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Accent color</b><small>Used across icons, controls, borders, navigation and effects.</small></div>
                <div class="accent-swatches" id="accent-swatches" role="group" aria-label="Accent color">
                  <button class="accent-swatch" type="button" data-accent="#5ee6c8" data-rgb="94,230,200" title="Teal" aria-label="Teal accent" style="--swatch:#5ee6c8"></button>
                  <button class="accent-swatch" type="button" data-accent="#ffb52e" data-rgb="255,181,46" title="Amber" aria-label="Amber accent" style="--swatch:#ffb52e"></button>
                  <button class="accent-swatch" type="button" data-accent="#66aaff" data-rgb="102,170,255" title="Blue" aria-label="Blue accent" style="--swatch:#66aaff"></button>
                  <button class="accent-swatch" type="button" data-accent="#b58cff" data-rgb="181,140,255" title="Purple" aria-label="Purple accent" style="--swatch:#b58cff"></button>
                  <button class="accent-swatch" type="button" data-accent="#62d6a2" data-rgb="98,214,162" title="Mint" aria-label="Mint accent" style="--swatch:#62d6a2"></button>
                  <button class="accent-swatch" type="button" data-accent="#ff6f78" data-rgb="255,111,120" title="Coral" aria-label="Coral accent" style="--swatch:#ff6f78"></button>
                  <button class="accent-swatch" type="button" data-accent="#5ed7df" data-rgb="94,215,223" title="Cyan" aria-label="Cyan accent" style="--swatch:#5ed7df"></button>
                  <button class="accent-swatch" type="button" data-accent="#f184c8" data-rgb="241,132,200" title="Pink" aria-label="Pink accent" style="--swatch:#f184c8"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="settings-current-accent">Choose a swatch to update the whole interface</div>
              </div>
              <div class="settings-option-row">
                <div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Background style</b><small>Choose the animated backdrop behind each page.</small></div>
                <div class="settings-option-control"><select class="engine-select" id="background-style"><option value="grid">Grid</option><option value="waves">Waves</option><option value="circles">Circles</option><option value="dots">Dynamic dots</option><option value="fluid">Fluid</option><option value="image">Image</option><option value="off">Off</option></select></div>
              </div>
              <div class="settings-option-row">
                <div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Background image</b><small>Upload an image for the Image background style.</small></div>
                <div class="settings-option-control"><label class="background-image-upload" for="background-image-upload">Choose image</label><input id="background-image-upload" class="background-image-file" type="file" accept="image/*"><button class="background-image-clear" id="clear-background-image" type="button">Remove</button></div>
              </div>
              <div class="settings-option-row">
                <div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Custom cursor</b><small>Choose how the pointer looks around Silverite.</small></div>
                <div class="settings-option-control"><select class="engine-select" id="cursor-style"><option value="default">Default</option><option value="pixel">Pixel arrow</option><option value="crosshair">Crosshair</option><option value="custom">Custom image</option></select></div>
              </div>
              <div class="cursor-image-editor" id="cursor-image-editor" hidden>
                <div class="cursor-image-editor-heading">
                  <div><b>Custom image cursor</b><small>Paste a direct image URL or upload an image from your device. Transparent PNGs work best.</small></div>
                  <span class="cursor-image-format">PNG · JPG · WEBP · GIF · SVG</span>
                </div>
                <div class="cursor-image-tools">
                  <div class="cursor-image-url-field">
                    <label for="cursor-image-url">IMAGE URL</label>
                    <div class="cursor-image-url-row">
                      <input class="cursor-image-url-input" id="cursor-image-url" type="url" placeholder="https://example.com/cursor.png" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
                      <button class="cursor-image-action" id="apply-cursor-url" type="button">USE URL</button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="cursor-image-upload-field">
                    <span class="cursor-image-upload-label">OR UPLOAD</span>
                    <label class="cursor-image-upload-button" for="cursor-image-upload">
                      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 16V4m0 0L7 9m5-5 5 5M4 16v4h16v-4"/></svg>
                      Choose image
                    </label>
                    <input id="cursor-image-upload" class="cursor-image-file-input" type="file" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif,image/svg+xml">
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="cursor-image-preview-row">
                  <div class="cursor-image-preview-box">
                    <img id="cursor-image-preview" alt="Custom cursor preview" hidden>
                    <span id="cursor-image-preview-empty">NO IMAGE</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="cursor-image-preview-copy">
                    <b id="cursor-image-status">No custom image selected</b>
                    <small id="cursor-image-detail">Uploaded images are optimized to a small transparent PNG and saved in this browser.</small>
                    <button id="clear-custom-cursor" class="cursor-image-clear" type="button" disabled>REMOVE CUSTOM CURSOR</button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="cursor-image-footnote">For best results, use a small image (around 32–64 px). The cursor hotspot is set to its top-left corner.</div>
              </div>
              <div class="settings-option-row">
                <div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Cursor glow</b><small>Show a soft accent-colored light that follows your pointer.</small></div>
                <div class="settings-option-control"><label class="switch"><input id="cursor-glow-enabled" type="checkbox"><span></span></label></div>
              </div>
              <div class="settings-option-row settings-option-row--stacked">
                <div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Glow intensity</b><small>Adjust how strong the background glow appears.</small></div>
                <div class="settings-option-control settings-range-control"><div class="range-control"><input id="cursor-glow-intensity" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="100"><output id="cursor-glow-value">100%</output></div></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section class="settings-section" id="settings-interface" aria-labelledby="settings-interface-title">
            <div class="settings-section-heading"><span class="settings-section-number">03</span><div><h2 id="settings-interface-title">Interface</h2><p>Choose which interface details stay visible and how it behaves.</p></div></div>
            <div class="settings-panel">
              <div class="settings-option-row"><div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Show clock</b><small>Display the live clock on the Proxy home page.</small></div><div class="settings-option-control"><label class="switch"><input id="show-clock" type="checkbox"><span></span></label></div></div>
              <div class="settings-option-row"><div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Reduce motion</b><small>Use calmer page transitions and scrolling.</small></div><div class="settings-option-control"><label class="switch"><input id="reduce-motion" type="checkbox"><span></span></label></div></div>
              <div class="settings-option-row"><div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Confirm before closing a game</b><small>Ask before leaving an active game screen.</small></div><div class="settings-option-control"><label class="switch"><input id="confirm-close-game" type="checkbox"><span></span></label></div></div>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section class="settings-section" id="settings-proxy" aria-labelledby="settings-proxy-title">
            <div class="settings-section-heading"><span class="settings-section-number">04</span><div><h2 id="settings-proxy-title">Proxy</h2><p>Choose which browsing engine Silverite should prefer.</p></div></div>
            <div class="settings-panel">
              <div class="settings-option-row"><div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Proxy engine</b><small>Scramjet is recommended. Ultraviolet is a legacy, unmaintained compatibility option.</small></div><div class="settings-option-control"><select class="engine-select" id="default-engine"><option value="scramjet">Scramjet</option><option value="ultraviolet">Ultraviolet</option></select></div></div>
              <div class="settings-option-row"><div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Transport</b><small>Switch between Libcurl and Epoxy if a site behaves differently.</small></div><div class="settings-option-control"><select class="engine-select" id="default-transport"><option value="libcurl">Libcurl</option><option value="epoxy">Epoxy</option></select></div></div>
              <div class="settings-inline-note"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 11v5M12 7h.01"/></svg><span>Run Silverite with <code>npm start</code> and open it at <code>http://localhost:8080</code> to use the proxy.</span></div>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section class="settings-section" id="settings-homeworkbot" aria-labelledby="settings-homeworkbot-title">
            <div class="settings-section-heading"><span class="settings-section-number">05</span><div><h2 id="settings-homeworkbot-title">HomeworkBot</h2><p>Studi 1.0 works offline. Add a model key to let it read photos and answer anything.</p></div></div>
            <div class="settings-panel">
              <div class="settings-option-row settings-option-row--stacked">
                <div class="settings-option-copy"><b>API key</b><small>Saved in this browser only. Leave it empty to use offline mode.</small></div>
                <div class="settings-option-control settings-field-control"><input class="settings-text-input" id="studi-api-key" type="password" placeholder="Your API key" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></div>
              </div>
              <div class="settings-option-row settings-option-row--stacked">
                <div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Endpoint</b><small>Any chat-completions URL that accepts images.</small></div>
                <div class="settings-option-control settings-field-control"><input class="settings-text-input" id="studi-endpoint" type="url" placeholder="https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></div>
              </div>
              <div class="settings-option-row settings-option-row--stacked">
                <div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Model</b><small>The model name sent to your endpoint.</small></div>
                <div class="settings-option-control settings-field-control"><input class="settings-text-input" id="studi-model" type="text" placeholder="gpt-4o-mini" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></div>
              </div>
              <div class="settings-inline-note"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 11v5M12 7h.01"/></svg><span>Without a key, Studi 1.0 solves math and unit conversions on this device and builds practice quizzes. With a key, your questions and photos are sent to the endpoint above.</span></div>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section class="settings-section" id="settings-advanced" aria-labelledby="settings-advanced-title">
            <div class="settings-section-heading"><span class="settings-section-number">06</span><div><h2 id="settings-advanced-title">Advanced</h2><p>Maintenance options for this Silverite installation.</p></div></div>
            <div class="settings-panel settings-panel--danger">
              <div class="settings-option-row settings-option-row--reset">
                <div class="settings-option-copy"><b>Reset all settings</b><small>Restore the default white accent and original interface preferences on this device.</small></div>
                <div class="settings-option-control"><button class="reset-settings-btn" id="reset-settings" type="button">Reset preferences</button></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="settings-footer-row">
        <div class="footer-note settings-footer-note">SILVERITE · PREFERENCES SAVE AUTOMATICALLY</div>
        <button class="secret-cat" id="secret-cat" type="button" title="psst..." aria-label="A little secret cat">
          <span class="secret-cat-hearts" id="secret-cat-hearts" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <svg class="secret-cat-svg" viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
            <path class="secret-cat-tail" d="M29 31c4.6.6 6.6-2.2 5.6-5.1"/>
            <path class="secret-cat-body" d="M11.5 33.5c.4-6.2 3.6-10.4 8.5-10.4s8.1 4.2 8.5 10.4Z"/>
            <path class="secret-cat-head" d="M12.6 22.4 11.4 13l5.9 3.6h5.4l5.9-3.6-1.2 9.4a9.1 9.1 0 0 1-7.4 4.6 9.1 9.1 0 0 1-7.4-4.6Z"/>
            <circle class="secret-cat-eye" cx="17.2" cy="20.4" r="1.15"/>
            <circle class="secret-cat-eye" cx="22.8" cy="20.4" r="1.15"/>
            <path class="secret-cat-nose" d="m20 22.9-1.1.9h2.2Z"/>
          </svg>
          <span class="secret-cat-bubble" id="secret-cat-bubble" aria-hidden="true">mrrp!</span>
          <img class="secret-cat-explosion" id="secret-cat-explosion" src="assets/secret/explosion.gif" alt="" hidden>
        </button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="view standard-view homework-view" id="view-homeworkbot">
      <div class="homework-wrap">
        <header class="studi-topbar">
          <div class="studi-brand">
            <span class="studi-brand-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9.2 18h5.6M10.3 21h3.4M12 3a6 6 0 0 0-3.6 10.8c.7.5 1.1 1.3 1.1 2.2h5c0-.9.4-1.7 1.1-2.2A6 6 0 0 0 12 3Z"/></svg></span>
            <span class="studi-brand-name">HomeworkBot</span>
            <span class="studi-badge" id="studi-badge">
              <span class="studi-badge-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              <small id="studi-status">Offline ready</small>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div class="studi-modes" role="tablist" aria-label="HomeworkBot mode">
            <button class="studi-mode is-active" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="true" data-studi-mode="normal">Normal</button>
            <button class="studi-mode" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="false" data-studi-mode="study">Study</button>
          </div>
        </header>

        <div class="studi-thread">
          <div class="studi-log" id="studi-log" role="log" aria-live="polite" aria-label="HomeworkBot conversation"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="studi-dock">
          <form class="studi-composer" id="studi-form" autocomplete="off">
            <div class="studi-attachment" id="studi-attachment" hidden>
              <img id="studi-attachment-preview" alt="Attached homework image">
              <span id="studi-attachment-name">image</span>
              <button class="studi-attachment-remove" id="studi-attachment-remove" type="button" aria-label="Remove attached image">×</button>
            </div>
            <div class="studi-composer-row">
              <label class="studi-attach" for="studi-image-input" title="Attach a photo of your homework" aria-label="Attach a photo of your homework">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="3"/><circle cx="8.5" cy="9.5" r="1.6"/><path d="m4 17 4.8-4.8a2 2 0 0 1 2.8 0L20 20"/></svg>
              </label>
              <input class="studi-file" id="studi-image-input" type="file" accept="image/*">
              <textarea class="studi-input" id="studi-input" rows="1" placeholder="Ask anything, or attach a photo…" aria-label="Message HomeworkBot"></textarea>
              <div class="studi-model">
                <button class="studi-model-btn" id="studi-model-btn" type="button" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="studi-model-menu" title="Choose model">
                  <span class="studi-model-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                  <span class="studi-model-label" id="studi-model-label">Studi 1.0</span>
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg>
                </button>
                <div class="studi-model-menu" id="studi-model-menu" role="listbox" aria-label="Choose a model" hidden>
                  <button class="studi-model-option is-selected" type="button" role="option" data-studi-engine="studi" aria-selected="true">
                    <span class="studi-model-check" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>
                    <span class="studi-model-copy"><b>Studi 1.0</b><small>On-device · works offline</small></span>
                  </button>
                  <button class="studi-model-option" type="button" role="option" data-studi-engine="model" aria-selected="false">
                    <span class="studi-model-check" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>
                    <span class="studi-model-copy"><b id="studi-model-name">No model connected</b><small id="studi-model-note">Add a key in Settings</small></span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button class="studi-send" id="studi-send" type="submit" aria-label="Send message" disabled>
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 19V5m0 0-6 6m6-6 6 6"/></svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
          <p class="studi-footnote">Studi 1.0 · <span id="studi-engine-note">works offline</span> · can make mistakes, so double-check important work.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="view standard-view changelog-view" id="view-changelog">
      <div class="changelog-wrap">
        <div class="eyebrow">THE BUILD HISTORY</div>
        <h1>Changelog.</h1>
        <p class="lede">New stuff, fixes, and quality-of-life upgrades made to Silverite.</p>
        <div class="changelog-list" id="changelog-list" aria-live="polite"><div class="changelog-empty">Loading changelogs…</div></div>
        <button class="changelog-older-toggle" id="changelog-older-toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false" hidden>View old changelogs</button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="view standard-view credits-view" id="view-credits">
      <div class="credits-wrap">
        <div class="eyebrow">THE PEOPLE BEHIND SILVERITE</div>
        <h1>Credits.</h1>
        <p class="lede">Silverite is an independent browser arcade, shaped by a few open projects and a lot of local games.</p>
        <div class="credits-grid">
          <article class="credit-card credit-card--lead">
            <div class="credit-kicker">CREATED & MAINTAINED BY</div>
            <h2>br4y</h2>
            <p>Design, code, and the occasional secret cat.</p>
            <span class="credit-tag">OWNER</span>
          </article>
          <article class="credit-card credit-card--wide">
            <div class="credit-kicker">GAME PROVIDERS</div>
            <h2>Game libraries</h2>
            <p>Silverite's catalog is made possible by these game collections.</p>
            <ul class="credit-providers">
              <li><b>GN-MATH</b><span>Browser games, covers, and assets.</span></li>
              <li><b>Seraph</b><span>A huge collection that expands the library.</span></li>
              <li><b>UGS</b><span>Single-file games and assets.</span></li>
            </ul>
          </article>
          <article class="credit-card">
            <div class="credit-kicker">PROXY TECHNOLOGY</div>
            <h2>Scramjet & Ultraviolet</h2>
            <p>The service-worker proxy engines that let Silverite browse the web.</p>
          </article>
          <article class="credit-card">
            <div class="credit-kicker">ASSETS & DELIVERY</div>
            <h2>jsDelivr & githack</h2>
            <p>Fast, pinned delivery for game catalogs, thumbnails, and source files.</p>
          </article>
          <article class="credit-card">
            <div class="credit-kicker">SPECIAL THANKS</div>
            <h2>Everyone testing Silverite</h2>
            <p>For the feedback, bug reports, and messages that keep this project moving.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
        <div class="footer-note credits-footer">MADE WITH ♥ BY BR4Y</div>
      </div>
    </section>

  </main>

<div class="command-palette" id="command-palette" hidden>
  <div class="command-backdrop" data-command-close></div>
  <div class="command-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="command-title">
    <div class="command-search-row">
      <svg class="icon command-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-4-4"/></svg>
      <input class="command-input" id="command-input" type="text" placeholder="Search pages, tabs, games, and actions…" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" role="combobox" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="command-results">
      <span class="command-key" aria-hidden="true">ESC</span>

const EXTERNAL_GAME_BLOCKLIST = new Set([
  "geometrydash", "geometrydashlite", "geometrydashsubzero", "geometrydashscratch",
  "geometrydashwave", "geometrydashbreeze", "geometrydash3d", "geometrydasheditor",
  "geometrydashworld", "geometrydashscratch3d"

function normalizeGameKey(value) {
  return String(value || "").normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
}
function makeGameGlyph(title) {
  return String(title).replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]/gi, "").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0,2).map(word => word[0]).join("").toUpperCase() || "G";
}
function titleFromUgsId(id) {
  const overrides = {
    cl1v1lol:"1v1 LOL", cl8ballpool:"8 Ball Pool", cl2048:"2048", clbadicecream:"Bad Ice Cream",
    clbaldidecomp:"Baldi's Basics Decompile", clbaldisbasics:"Baldi's Basics", clbasketballlegends:"Basketball Legends",
    clbaseballbros:"Baseball Bros", clblockblast:"Block Blast", clbloxorz:"Bloxorz", clbrotato:"Brotato",
    clcookieclicker:"Cookie Clicker", cldoodlejump:"Doodle Jump", clducklife:"Duck Life", cleggycar:"Eggy Car",
    clfnaw:"Five Nights at Winston's", clgdlite:"Geometry Dash Lite", clgranny3:"Granny 3", clgrowagarden:"Grow a Garden",
    clhappywheels:"Happy Wheels", clhollowknight:"Hollow Knight", clmoto3:"Moto X3M", clpapasfreezeria:"Papa's Freezeria",
    clragdollarchers:"Ragdoll Archers", clrun3:"Run 3", clsnowrider:"Snow Rider", clslope:"Slope",
    clsoccerbros:"Soccer Bros", clspacewaves:"Space Waves", clstacktris:"Stacktris", clstealbrainrot:"Steal Brainrot",
    cltetris:"Tetris", clundertale:"Undertale", clwrestlebros:"Wrestle Bros"
  };
  if (overrides[id]) return overrides[id];
  const thumbnailPath = UGS_THUMB_PATHS[id];
  if (thumbnailPath) {
    const folder = thumbnailPath.split("/")[0];
    const readableFolder = folder.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2").replace(/[_-]+/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    if (/\s/.test(readableFolder)) {
      return readableFolder.split(" ").map(word => word.length <= 3 && /[A-Z0-9]/.test(word) ? word.toUpperCase() : word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1)).join(" ");
    }
  }
  let title = String(id).replace(/^cl/i, "");
  title = title.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2").replace(/([A-Z])([A-Z][a-z])/g, "$1 $2").replace(/[_-]+/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  return title.split(" ").map(word => word.length <= 3 && /[A-Z0-9]/.test(word) ? word.toUpperCase() : word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1)).join(" ") || title;
}
function shouldAddExternalGame(name, seen) {
  const key = normalizeGameKey(name);
  if (!key || seen.has(key) || EXTERNAL_GAME_BLOCKLIST.has(key)) return false;
  if (/(^|[^a-z])fnae([^a-z]|$)|(^|[^a-z])bige([^a-z]|$)/i.test(String(name))) return false;
  return true;
}
function appendExternalGames(entries, source, seen) {
  const arts = ["gray","violet","blue","mint","orange","pink","gold","green"];
  let added = 0;
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const name = String(entry.name || "").trim();
    const url = String(entry.url || "").trim();
    if (!name || !isAllowedGameAssetUrl(url, "game") || !shouldAddExternalGame(name, seen)) continue;
    const image = entry.image && isAllowedGameAssetUrl(entry.image, "image") ? String(entry.image) : "";
    const imageCandidates = Array.isArray(entry.imageCandidates) ? entry.imageCandidates.filter(candidate=>isAllowedGameAssetUrl(candidate,"image")) : [];
    const game = {
      name, file: String(entry.file || url.split(/[?#]/)[0].split("/").pop() || name), url, image,
      imageCandidates,
      glyph: makeGameGlyph(name), art: arts[g4m3s.length % arts.length], source,
      launchMode: entry.launchMode || "iframe", actionLabel: entry.actionLabel || "PLAY"
    };
    g4m3s.push(game);
    seen.add(normalizeGameKey(name));
    added++;
  }
  return added;
}
async function fetchExternalText(url, timeoutMs = 16000) {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, { mode:"cors", credentials:"omit", cache:"force-cache", referrerPolicy:"no-referrer", signal:controller.signal });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
    return await response.text();
  } finally { clearTimeout(timeout); }
}
async function fetchGnMathEntries() {
  const response = await fetchExternalText(EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_CONFIG.gnMath.catalog);
  const rows = JSON.parse(response);
  return rows.filter(row => row && Number(row.id) >= 0 && row.name && row.url && String(row.url).includes("{HTML_URL}/"))
    .map(row => ({
      name: row.name,
      file: `gn-math/${row.id}`,
      url: String(row.url).replace("{HTML_URL}", EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_CONFIG.gnMath.htmlRoot),
      image: row.cover ? String(row.cover).replace("{COVER_URL}", EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_CONFIG.gnMath.coversRoot) : ""
    }));
}
async function fetchUgsEntries() {
  const script = await fetchExternalText(EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_CONFIG.ugs.catalog);
  const match = script.match(/let\s+files\s*=\s*(\[[\s\S]*?\])\s*;/);
  if (!match) throw new Error("UGS game list format was not recognized");
  const files = JSON.parse(match[1]);
  return files.filter(file => typeof file === "string" && file.startsWith("cl") && !UGS_MISSING_FILES.has(file) && !/[�]/.test(file))
    .map(file => ({
      name: titleFromUgsId(file),
      file: `ugs/${file}.html`,
      url: EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_CONFIG.ugs.htmlRoot + encodeURIComponent(file) + ".html",
      image: UGS_THUMB_PATHS[file] ? EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_CONFIG.ugs.assetsRoot + UGS_THUMB_PATHS[file].split("/").map(encodeURIComponent).join("/") : ""
    }));
}
async function fetchSeraphEntries() {
  const response = await fetchExternalText(EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_CONFIG.seraph.catalog);
  const rows = JSON.parse(response);
  const thumbnailRoot=EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_CONFIG.seraph.thumbnailRoot;
  const makeThumbnailCandidates=row=>{
    const candidates=[];const add=value=>{if(value&&!candidates.includes(value))candidates.push(value);};
    for(const value of [row.thumbnail,row.image,row.cover,row.coverImage]){
      if(typeof value!=='string'||!value.trim())continue;
      const raw=value.trim();
      if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)){add(raw);continue;}
      const relative=raw.replace(/^\/?images\/thumbnails\//i,'').replace(/^\/+/, '');
      if(/\.[a-z0-9]{2,5}$/i.test(relative))add(thumbnailRoot+relative.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/'));
      else if(relative)add(thumbnailRoot+relative.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/')+'.png');
    }
    const urlParts=String(row.url||'').split('/').filter(Boolean);
    let folder=urlParts[urlParts.length-1]||'';
    if(/\.[a-z0-9]{2,5}$/i.test(folder))folder=urlParts[urlParts.length-2]||folder.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'');
    const nameSlug=String(row.name||'').normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-|-$/g,'');
    for(const stem of [folder,nameSlug,String(row.name||'').trim()].filter(Boolean)){
      if(/\.[a-z0-9]{2,5}$/i.test(stem))add(thumbnailRoot+stem.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/'));
      else for(const extension of ['png','jpg'])add(thumbnailRoot+stem.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/')+'.'+extension);
    }
    return candidates;
  };
  return rows.filter(row => row && row.name && typeof row.url === "string" && row.url.startsWith("/games/"))
    .map(row => {
      const imageCandidates=makeThumbnailCandidates(row);
      return {
        name: row.name,
        file: `seraph/${row.url.replace(/^\/+/, "")}`,
        url: EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_CONFIG.seraph.root + row.url.replace(/^\/+/, ""),
        image: imageCandidates[0]||"",
        imageCandidates
      };
    });
}
async function loadExternalGameLibraries() {
  const seen = new Set(g4m3s.map(game => normalizeGameKey(game.name)));
  const results = await Promise.allSettled([fetchGnMathEntries(), fetchUgsEntries(), fetchSeraphEntries()]);
  let gnCount = 0, ugsCount = 0, seraphCount = 0;
  if (results[0].status === "fulfilled") gnCount = appendExternalGames(results[0].value, "GN-MATH", seen); else console.warn("GN-MATH catalog could not load:", results[0].reason);
  if (results[1].status === "fulfilled") ugsCount = appendExternalGames(results[1].value, "UGS", seen); else console.warn("UGS catalog could not load:", results[1].reason);
  if (results[2].status === "fulfilled") seraphCount = appendExternalGames(results[2].value, "SERAPH", seen); else console.warn("Seraph catalog could not load:", results[2].reason);
  const freezeNova = [
    {name:"FreezeNova Catalog",url:"https://app.freezenova.com/"},
    {name:"Ragdoll Archers",url:"https://app.freezenova.com/class/ragdoll-archers"},
    {name:"Moto X3M 3",url:"https://app.freezenova.com/class/moto-x3m-3"},
    {name:"Five Nights at Freddy's 2",url:"https://app.freezenova.com/class/five-nights-at-freddys-2"},
    {name:"Steal Brainrot Heist",url:"https://app.freezenova.com/class/steal-brainrot-heist"}
  ].map(game => ({...game,launchMode:"external",actionLabel:game.name==="FreezeNova Catalog"?"BROWSE":"OPEN"}));
  const freezeCount = appendExternalGames(freezeNova, "FREEZENOVA", seen);
  renderg4m3s();
  window.SILVERITE_SOURCE_COUNTS = { gnMath:gnCount, ugs:ugsCount, seraph:seraphCount, freezeNova:freezeCount };
  console.info("Silverite external game sources loaded", window.SILVERITE_SOURCE_COUNTS);
  return window.SILVERITE_SOURCE_COUNTS;
}
// Warm every local game thumbnail and each playable game document.
// The browser decides how long cached files are retained. Cross-origin game pages need CORS to be fetch-preloaded.
const GAME_PRELOAD_ITEMS = [
  ...Array.from(new Set([
    ...g4m3s.map(game => game.image).filter(Boolean)
  ])).map(url => ({kind:'image', label:url, url})),
  ...g4m3s.map(game => ({kind:'game', label:game.file, url:game.url}))
];
async function consumeResponseBody(response){
  if(!response.body){await response.arrayBuffer();return;}
  const reader=response.body.getReader();
  try{while(true){const part=await reader.read();if(part.done)break;}}
  finally{try{reader.releaseLock();}catch(e){}}
}
async function preloadAsset(item){
  if(item.kind==='image'){
    await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
      const image=new Image();
      image.onload=()=>resolve();
      image.onerror=()=>reject(new Error('Image preload failed'));
      image.decoding='async';
      image.referrerPolicy='no-referrer';
      image.src=item.url;
    });
    return;
  }
  const response=await fetch(item.url,{method:'GET',mode:'cors',credentials:'omit',cache:'force-cache',referrerPolicy:'no-referrer'});
  if(!response.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+response.status);
  await consumeResponseBody(response);
}
function startFullAssetPreload(){
  const chip=$('#preload-status'),text=$('#preload-status-text');
  if(!chip||!text||chip.dataset.started==='true')return;
  chip.dataset.started='true';chip.hidden=false;
  const total=GAME_PRELOAD_ITEMS.length;
  let completed=0,failed=0,next=0,lastLabel='';
  const concurrency=4;
  const update=()=>{
    const prefix=completed<total?'PRELOADING':'PRELOAD COMPLETE';
    const suffix=failed?` · ${failed} FAILED`:'';
    text.textContent=`${prefix} ${completed}/${total}${suffix}${lastLabel&&completed<total?' · '+lastLabel:''}`;
    chip.title=lastLabel||'Caching game files and images in this browser';
  };
  update();
  async function worker(){
    while(next<GAME_PRELOAD_ITEMS.length){
      const item=GAME_PRELOAD_ITEMS[next++];
      lastLabel=item.label;
      try{await preloadAsset(item);}catch(error){failed++;}
      completed++;
      update();
    }
  }
  Promise.all(Array.from({length:Math.min(concurrency,total)},()=>worker())).then(()=>{
    chip.classList.add('done');
    text.textContent=`PRELOAD COMPLETE ${completed}/${total}${failed?` · ${failed} FAILED`:''}`;
    chip.title=failed?`${failed} asset(s) could not be cached. They can still load when opened.`:'All game HTML files and image files were requested and cached where the browser permits.';
    if(failed===0){setTimeout(()=>{chip.hidden=true;},5000);}
  }).catch(()=>{
    chip.classList.add('done');
    text.textContent=`PRELOAD STOPPED ${completed}/${total}`;
  });
}

  const path = ICON_PATHS[name] || ICON_PATHS.grid;
  return `<svg class="${className}" width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${path}</svg>`;
}

const SETTINGS_KEY='silverite-settings-v2';
const LEGACY_SETTINGS_KEY='silverite-settings-v1';
const DEFAULT_SETTINGS={accent:'#5ee6c8',accentRgb:'94,230,200',cursorStyle:'default',cursorImage:'',cursorGlow:true,glowIntensity:100,backgroundStyle:'grid',backgroundImage:'',backgroundGrid:true,showClock:true,reduceMotion:false,confirmClose:false,defaultEngine:'scramjet',defaultTransport:'libcurl',studiKey:'',studiEndpoint:'',studiModel:''};
let userSettings={...DEFAULT_SETTINGS};
try{
  const currentSettings=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SETTINGS_KEY)||'null');
  if(currentSettings&&typeof currentSettings==='object'){
    userSettings={...DEFAULT_SETTINGS,...currentSettings};
    if(!Object.hasOwn(currentSettings,'backgroundStyle'))userSettings.backgroundStyle=currentSettings.backgroundGrid===false?'off':'grid';
  }else{
    const legacySettings=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_SETTINGS_KEY)||'null');
    if(legacySettings&&typeof legacySettings==='object'){
      userSettings={...DEFAULT_SETTINGS,...legacySettings};
      if(!Object.hasOwn(legacySettings,'backgroundStyle'))userSettings.backgroundStyle=legacySettings.backgroundGrid===false?'off':'grid';
      // The old release used amber or white as its built-in default. Migrate those to teal,
      // while preserving any accent the user deliberately chose.
      if(String(legacySettings.accent||'').toLowerCase()==='#ffb52e'){
        userSettings.accent='#5ee6c8';
        userSettings.accentRgb='94,230,200';
      }
      localStorage.setItem(SETTINGS_KEY,JSON.stringify(userSettings));
    }
  }
}catch(e){}

const proxyDiagnostics=[];
const PROXY_DIAGNOSTIC_LIMIT=250;
function diagnosticText(value){
  if(value instanceof Error)return `${value.name}: ${value.message}${value.stack?`\n${value.stack}`:''}`;
  if(typeof value==='string')return value;
  try{return JSON.stringify(value)}catch(error){return String(value)}
}
function logProxyDiagnostic(kind,message,details=''){
  const time=new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
  proxyDiagnostics.push(`[${time}] ${kind.toUpperCase()} ${message}${details?`\n${details}`:''}`);
  if(proxyDiagnostics.length>PROXY_DIAGNOSTIC_LIMIT)proxyDiagnostics.splice(0,proxyDiagnostics.length-PROXY_DIAGNOSTIC_LIMIT);
  const output=$('#diagnostics-output');
  if(output){output.textContent=proxyDiagnostics.join('\n\n');output.scrollTop=output.scrollHeight;}
}
for(const method of ['error','warn']){
  const original=console[method].bind(console);
  console[method]=(...args)=>{logProxyDiagnostic(method,args.map(diagnosticText).join(' '));original(...args);};
}
window.addEventListener('error',event=>logProxyDiagnostic('error',event.message||'Uncaught page error',event.error?diagnosticText(event.error):`${event.filename||''}:${event.lineno||0}:${event.colno||0}`));
window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',event=>logProxyDiagnostic('error','Unhandled promise rejection',diagnosticText(event.reason)));
function setDiagnosticsOpen(open){
  const panel=$('#proxy-diagnostics');
  if(!panel)return;
  panel.hidden=!open;
  $('#toggle-diagnostics')?.classList.toggle('active',open);
  if(open&&!proxyDiagnostics.length)logProxyDiagnostic('info','Console ready. Reproduce the proxy error to capture details.');
}
function escapeHTML(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]))}
function cardTemplate(game){
  const safe=escapeHTML(game.name);const fav=favorites.has(game.name);const thumbnail=game.image?escapeHTML(game.image):'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/braydensrandomcreations/silverite@main/assets/no-thumbnail.png';const placeholderFlag=game.image?'':'data-placeholder="true"';const candidateAttr=game.imageCandidates?.length?`data-image-candidates="${escapeHTML(JSON.stringify(game.imageCandidates))}" data-image-candidate-index="0"`:'';const image=`<img class="game-thumb" src="${thumbnail}" ${placeholderFlag} ${candidateAttr} alt="" loading="lazy" decoding="async" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" onerror="if(this.dataset.imageCandidates){const c=JSON.parse(this.dataset.imageCandidates);const i=Number(this.dataset.imageCandidateIndex||0)+1;if(i<c.length){this.dataset.imageCandidateIndex=i;this.src=c[i];return}}if(this.dataset.placeholder){this.remove();this.parentElement.classList.remove('has-thumb')}else{this.dataset.placeholder='true';this.src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/braydensrandomcreations/silverite@main/assets/no-thumbnail.png'}">`;
  const source=game.source?`<div class="game-source">${escapeHTML(game.source)}</div>`:'';
  const action=escapeHTML(game.actionLabel||'PLAY');
  return `<article class="game-card" data-game="${safe}"><div class="game-art art-${game.art} has-thumb">${image}<span class="art-glyph thumb-fallback">${escapeHTML(game.glyph||'G')}</span><button class="game-fav ${fav?'favorited':''}" data-fav="${safe}" aria-label="${fav?'Remove from':'Add to'} favorites">${svgIcon('heart',16,'icon',fav)}</button></div><div class="game-name" title="${safe}">${safe}</div>${source}<button class="play-btn" data-play="${safe}">${action}</button></article>`
}
